notes.title: 10/1(Wed) QoL Improvements Update Info
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants!

 

The October 1 (Wed) update will bring a variety of new content, including the addition of Sword weapons, along with several improvements aimed at enhancing overall gameplay convenience.

 

Here’s a preview of the major QoL improvements in this update, and we appreciate your continued support for the upcoming October update.

 

■ Major QoL Improvements

(1) Removal of Reactor Weapon Optimization Conditions

- To allow for more flexible use of different weapons and improve accessibility for new players, Optimization Conditions that were only applied when equipping specific weapons will be removed.

- Accordingly, the "Reactor Implant" function in the Auxiliary Workbench, related Quests, and Awards will also be removed.

- Additionally, with the removal of Optimization Conditions, the Skill Power increase that previously activated when meeting these conditions will be incorporated into the Reactor's base Skill Power. 

 

(2) Changes to Amorphous Material Opening Method

- To reduce the hassle of opening Amorphous Materials, this function will be improved to allow single or continuous opening through interaction with NPCs located in Albion.

- As a result, the Reconstructed Devices that were created when clearing Void Intercept Battles and Void Fusion Reactors will be removed.

- Additionally, please note that the Void Intercept Battle: Hard will be revised in the future and the current content format will be maintained until then.

 

(3) Laboratory Improvements

- The "Legion of Breach," a new legion introduced in Season 3 Axion Plains, will be added to the Laboratory Legion settings.

- The maximum number of Common Monsters that can be summoned in the Laboratory will be increased to 50.

 

We will continue to consider and implement improvements to enhance convenience and satisfaction for our Descendants.

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Patch 1.3.4
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants!

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Patch 1.3.4.

Descendants, please reconnect to the game for smoother gameplay.

 

■ Patch Date

- 09.11.2025 (Thu) 00:00 PDT

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Patch Details

(1) UI & UX

- Improved sorting functionality for Weapons, Reactors, External Components, and Modules.

ㄴ Added several new items to the sorting list.

ㄴ Unified sorting criteria that were previously different for each item category to ensure all items are sorted using the same criteria.

- Improved the Axion Plains mission “AX Power Converter Station” so that the rate at which Defense Time decreases based on the number of protected objects is now visually displayed in the upper mission UI.

 

(2) Miscellaneous

- When viewing a Descendant's profile, made improvements to display "No information available." text if the target user has not unlocked Inversion Reinforcement.

 

Bug Fixes

(1) Content

- Fixed an issue in the Axion Plains mission “First Crater” where progression was blocked because the required monster kill count in certain sections was not registered correctly

- Arche Trace - In the "Replay Cutscenes" of the Luna-exclusive quest, Arche Traces will only be activate when Luna or Ultimate Luna are equipped.

ㄴ Albion - The Concert Begins!

ㄴ Kingston - A New Moon Rises

- Fixed an issue where Abyss Scarabs would move abnormally when damaged during their Regeneration animation.

- Fixed an intermittent issue where it was sometimes impossible to progress the quest “Let’s See Who Wins – Come up with taunting comments” during Luna’s exclusive questline.

 

(2) Descendants

Lepic

- Fixed an issue where the Grenade Throw Skill could be repeatedly used faster than normal when transitioning to other actions.

ㄴ This applies to all Grenade Throw Modification Modules.

ㆍ Nerve Infiltration and Explosive Stacks

Luna

- Fixed an issue where Notes would appear instantly and couldn't be hit with equipped Unique Weapons.

- Fixed an issue where Perfect Pitch effect wasn't being applied correctly.

- Fixed an issue where enhancement effects from Enhanced Skills weren't converting to Standard Skill effects.

- Fixed an issue where the Inspiration Gauge wasn't being correctly acquired when equipped with the "Nimble Footsteps" Module.

- Fixed the range indicator for "Fever Time!" in the Battlefield Concert.

ㄴ Changed from 3.5m to 7m forward

- Fixed the incorrect representation of Enhanced Skills in all Skill videos for Ultimate Luna's "Singer's Mercy" Module.

- Fixed the incorrect representation of the "Delightful Stage" Skill video when using Ultimate Luna's "Aggressive Melody" Module.

- Fixed an issue where the cooldown was applied when using Firearms and Skills simultaneously during "Fever Time!" while using Ultimate Luna's "Battlefield Concert" Module.

 

(3) Modules

- Fixed an issue where the Ultimate Tier Descendant Module's "Arche Concretion" effect was not reducing Firearm Explosive ATK.

- Fixed an issue where the Ultimate Tier Descendant Module “Walk a Tightrope” effect did not apply to Firearm Explosive ATK.

 

(4) UI & UX

- Fixed an issue where the "Non-Attribute" text was not displaying correctly in the Mission Details pop-up reward information.

- Fixed an issue where Matchmaking appeared to be canceled when the map changed immediately after applying for Void Erosion Purge: Normal Difficulty Stage 10 matching.

- Fixed an issue where attachment slots were visible in the Vehicle customization UI

- Fixed an issue where the PS Store icon overlapped with the Inbox button in the Shop.

 

(5) Miscellaneous

- Fixed an issue where discounts for owned items were not properly applied when purchasing the “Lounge Bundle.”

- Fixed an issue where Caliber was consumed when purchasing a Descendant while holding the “Descendant Purchase Ticket A, B, C.”

- Fixed an issue where purchasable Attendance Days were one day short of the maximum achievable days.

- Fixed an issue where the Tactical Mobility Teleporter at the Outpost in Vespers Moonlight Lake was floating.

- Fixed an issue where some item names were not displaying in the ETA Shop.

- Reset the purchase limit from 30 to 100 when buying Consumables, Gold, and Kuiper Shards with Quality Certified ETA Voucher.

- Modified Collectible Coins and Premium Collectible Coins to be included in the Library Consumables progress and to display their quantities in the Library.

 

Thank you.

notes.content:
(#7) 2025.09.18(Thu) 00:10 PDT – Known Issues have been updated and some issues have been resolved through Patch 1.3.5.

(#1) 2025.09.04(Thu) 19:00 PDT – Known Issues have been updated, and some issues have been resolved through 1.3.3b Patch.

 

Greetings, Descendants.

 

Here are the major issues that were found for The First Descendant in September.

 

We will continue to update this notice with any newly identified issues and bugs, as well as previously reported major issues. Please keep track of the updates during your gameplay.

 

\[September 11th]

■ (#7)(Resolved) Issue where the “Chain Catalyst” effect of Mutant Cells is not applied properly

- An issue has been identified where the maximum attribute resistance reduction effect granted to the target when applying the “Chain Catalyst” effect is not properly reflected.
ㄴ Affected Mutant Cells: Arche Chain Catalyst, Fire Chain Catalyst, Chill Chain Catalyst, Toxin Chain Catalyst, Electric Chain Catalyst

 

■ (#7)(Resolved) Issue where certain Battle Pass weekly challenge achievements are not applied properly

- An issue has been identified where some Battle Pass weekly challenges are not achieved even when the conditions are fulfilled or are achieved even when the conditions are not fulfilled.

 

\[September 10th]

■ (#6) (Resolved) An issue where Caliber is consumed when purchasing a Descendant while in possession of “Descendant Purchase Ticket A, B, C”

- We have identified an issue where Descendants could only be purchased with Caliber even when “Descendant Purchase Ticket A, B, C” were in possession.
- This issue is scheduled to be resolved in the 1.3.4 patch.

 

■ (#6) (Resolved) An issue where discounts are not properly applied when purchasing the “Lounge Bundle” while in possession of relevant items”

- This issue is scheduled to be resolved in the 1.3.4 patch.

- Any Caliber charged without discount will be refunded, with further details to be announced in a separate notice.

 

\[September 8th]

■ (#7)(Resolved) An issue where when equipping the Battlefield Concert module for Ultimate Luna, the Fever Time! effect does not end

- This issue is scheduled to be fixed in the upcoming patch this week.

- As this issue has caused abnormal effects on leaderboard records, all leaderboard data will be reset after the patch.

- We apologize for the inconvenience and will continue to do our best to provide a more stable service.

- (Updated) The fix for this issue was originally planned for this week’s patch. However, during final testing we identified additional, unexpected problems.

- To properly resolve these and complete further testing, we need more time. As a result, the fix could not be included in this week’s update.

- We apologize for not being able to meet the patch schedule we previously communicated. Our team is working to finish testing and will release the patch as quickly as possible once everything has been addressed.

- Additionally, the reset of abnormal leaderboard records related to Ultimate Luna will be applied when this patch goes live.

 

\[September 5th]

■ (#6) (Resolved) An issue where during Luna Exclusive Quest, the objective “Let’s See Who Wins - Come up with taunting comments” could intermittently not be progressed

- We have identified an issue where, during one of Luna’s Exclusive Quests, the objective “Let’s See Who Wins – Come up with taunting comments” could intermittently not progress.

- The quest can be progressed by moving to another field. Until the fix is implemented, please continue using this method.

 

■ (#3) (Resolved) An issue where the target NPC would intermittently not appear, preventing quest progression

- We have identified an issue where, during quest progression, the target NPC would intermittently not appear, making it impossible to proceed.

 

■ (#7)(Resolved) An issue where the item acquisition effect was not displayed properly

- We have identified an issue where the item acquisition effect was displayed identically, instead of varying according to the acquisition history.

 

\[September 4th]

■ An issue where effects not actually applied were incorrectly listed in the description of the ‘Nerve Infiltration’ module

- We have identified an issue where the description of the ‘Nerve Infiltration’ module incorrectly indicates that it grants the ‘Weaken Regeneration’ effect.

- The effect is not actually applied, and the module description will be corrected with the 1.3.6 patch.

 

■ (#1)(Resolved) \[PS]\[XBOX] Ultimate Descendant Skin Appearance Not Displayed When Checking Details

- We have identified an issue where the appearance of Ultimate Descendant skins is not displayed when checking the skin details in the Shop while equipping a Normal Descendant.

- Until the issue is fixed, you can still view the skin appearance by hovering over the bundle item and clicking the “Preview” button.

- A patch to fix this issue is currently being prepared, and we will provide further notice once it has been applied.

 

\[Previous Known Issues]

■ An issue where Sharen's 'Rabbit Game' body skin dye is not applied to certain parts

 

■ Intel CPU Issue

- Crashes have been reported on some Intel 13th and 14th generation CPUs.

- On PCs using these CPUs, the game may forcefully shut down with an error message stating 'Out of video memory' when launched.

This issue can be partially resolved by adjusting power limits in the BIOS.

- We are awaiting a response from Intel regarding this issue, and we are sharing Intel's official response for your reference.

 

■ Temporary solutions for client termination issues with certain antivirus Programs

- We have requested for exceptions for The First Descendant to antivirus programs, but some have not been implemented. Below are temporary solutions for this problem.

(1) ‘Bitdefender’ Temporary Solution \[FAQ]

- Go to System Protection > Advanced Threat Detection (ATD) > Manage Exclusions menu, select the file or folder for The First Descendant, and save.

(2) ‘McAfee Agent’ Temporary Solution \[FAQ]

- Go to McAfee Security > Navigation > Quarantined and Trusted Items, select TheFirstDescendant.exe from the quarantined programs list, and restore it.

 

■ Solutions for ‘Easy Anti-Cheat’ not functioning correctly

- If Easy Anti-Cheat malfunctions, refer to the FAQ for solutions. If the issue persists, please contact customer support with relevant screenshots.

- Customer Support Access: Official Website > Customer Support > FAQ > Contact Us

 

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.3.3
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants!
 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.3.3.

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Update 1.3.3

Lounge

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/49d607a53f2f6a80dfabb2c1caab6e1f5e49f212.png"]

- The Lounge is a place where Descendants can relax and take breaks between missions.

- You can enter the Lounge in Albion.

ㄴ You can enter the Lounge by carrying out the sub quest  that begins after the main quest  is completed.

- You can place Descendants, Fellows, Vehicles, Weapon Skins, Back Attachments, Chest Attachments, and newly added Collectible items in the Lounge.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p align="center"]Categories
[/td][td][p align="center"]Text
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Descendants
[/td][td]
- You can place Descendants you own in the Lounge.

- If you own both the Normal and Ultimate versions of a Descendant, only the Ultimate Descendant can be placed.

- You can select a customization loadout to apply to Descendants placed in the Lounge.

- You can approach and chat with Descendants who are not assuming Lounge Poses.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Lounge Pose
[/td][td]
- Descendants placed in the Lounge will assume the Lounge Poses you own.

- You can select a Lounge Pose to assume from the Place Descendant screen, and lock a Lounge Pose to repeat.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Fellows
[/td][td]
- You can place Fellows you own in the Lounge.

- You can select a customization loadout to apply to Fellows placed in the Lounge.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Vehicle
[/td][td]
- You can place Vehicles you own in the Lounge.

- Vehicles placed in the Lounge will have their Customization settings applied.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Weapon Skins
[/td][td]
- You can place Weapon Skins for any weapon you've ever owned in the Lounge.

- Weapon Skins placed in the Lounge will have their Paint settings applied.

- Weapon Skins placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Chest Attachments/Back Attachments
[/td][td]
- You can place Chest Attachments/Back Attachments you own in the Lounge.

- Chest Attachments/Back Attachments placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Lounge Collectibles (Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas)
[/td][td]
- You can place Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas you own in the Lounge.

- Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.

- You can rotate Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines to change their placement orientation.

- You can place Figurines on Dioramas.
[/td][/tr][/table]
- Random Placement

ㄴ When you enter the Lounge, your Descendants are randomly placed.

ㄴ When the Descendants are randomly placed, their loadouts are randomly selected and applied.

ㄴ Random Placement settings can be changed via the guide in the Lounge.

- Lounge Atmosphere

ㄴ When you enter the Lounge, lighting and weather are randomly applied.

ㄴ The Lounge atmosphere can be changed via the guide in the Lounge.

- Lounge Extension

ㄴ Upon reaching Mastery Rank 5, you can spend 1 million Gold to extend your Lounge by building a Bedroom.

ㄴ You can place additional Descendants, Weapon Skins, Back Attachments, Chest Attachments, Ornaments, Trophies, and Figurines in the Bedroom.

ㄴ Some Lounge Poses can only be viewed through Descendants placed in the Bedroom.

- Lounge Photo Mode follows different rules from normal Photo Mode.

ㄴ Only free movement is allowed in Lounge Photo Mode.

ㄴ There is no Subject Tab in Lounge Photo Mode.

ㄴ You can save presets in Lounge Photo Mode separately from the presets saved in normal Photo Mode.

 

Collectibles

- Collectibles are items that can be placed in the Lounge for viewing.

ㄴ Ornaments: Collectibles that become increasingly detailed as they level up.

ㄴ Figurines: Collectibles that can be placed directly in the Lounge or on Dioramas.

ㄴ Trophies: Collectibles obtained by completing Awards.

ㄴ Dioramas: Sets that serve as backdrops for placing Figurines.

ㄴ Lounge Poses: Actions that Descendants placed in the Lounge can perform.

- Ornaments and Figurines can be obtained by purchasing Common or Premium Collectibles Boxes via the "Purchase Collectibles" feature from Collec-T in Albion or Edi-T in the Lounge.

ㄴ One Common Collectibles Box can be purchased with 100 Collectible Coins, and one Premium Collectibles Box can be purchased with 100 Premium Collectible Coins.

- Some Ornaments, Figurines, Dioramas, and Lounge Poses can be obtained by spending Collectible Coins via the "Exchange Collectibles" feature.

ㄴ Any remaining Collectible Coins can also be exchanged for small amounts of Gold, Kuiper Shards, Quantum Incubators, or Void Abyss Metal Fragments.

- Ornaments and Figurines obtained from Common and Premium Collectibles Boxes can be dismantled using the "Dismantle Collectible" feature for 25 Collectible Coins each.

- Trophies can be earned by completing Intercept Battle Awards.

- Collectible Coins can be earned by completing the missions below or defeating monsters.

ㄴ 400% Infiltration Operation: 12 coins

ㄴ High-risk Difficulty Sigma Sector: 20 coins

ㄴ (Normal/Operational Area) Axion Plains: 28 coins

ㄴ Hard Difficulty Void Vessel: 40 coins

ㄴ Defeating an Axion Plains Commander has a low chance to obtain 100 coins.

ㄴ Defeating the Wall Crasher guarantees 100 coins, with a low chance of obtaining an additional 1000 coins.

- Premium Collectible Coins can be earned as rewards below.

ㄴ High-risk Difficulty Sigma Sector - Today's Bonus

ㆍ Broken Boundary: 250 coins

ㆍ Isolated Desert: 250 coins

ㄴ Axion Plains - Operational Area mission (Dimensional Energy Stabilization Reading Reward)

ㆍ Dimensional Energy Stabilization Reward: 300 coins

 

New Descendant: Ultimate Luna

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/0f511ac8a15169ecaffbba2ad9038b73d5f2798d.png"]

- Added a new Ultimate Descendant, Ultimate Luna.

- Skill Module 1: Battlefield Concert

ㄴ Luna mounts her Unique Weapon and attacks enemies. Provides notes that are different from normal, and Inspiration Gauge is gained by shooting and using skills.

ㄴ Using the skill grants Luna a buff, attacking an enemy while the buff is active inflicts a debuff on the enemy.

ㄴ Using the skill when the Inspiration Gauge is full activates Enhanced Skills and grants Luna the "Fever Time!" effect.

ㄴ During “Fever Time!”, all of Luna's notes are judged as Successful, her Unique Weapon's firing rate increases, and she inflicts a stronger debuff on enemies.

ㄴ While the Fan Service skill effect is active, if auto-targeting is not used when aiming, Luna fires additional shots in the direction of the crosshair.

- Skill Module 2: Battlefield Artist

ㄴ Instead of using her Unique Weapon, Luna uses the firearm equipped in the slot to attack enemies.

ㄴ Using the skill grants Luna a buff, which is applied when she uses the Remix skill.

ㄴ Using Remix grants a buff to allies within range based on the color of the Inspiration Gauge.

- New skill modules can be obtained through the following:

ㄴ Rewards for defeating the Wall Crasher

ㄴ Rewards for completing Axion Plains missions

ㄴ Additional rewards from Axion Plains Operational Area

ㄴ Combining modules

- Ultimate Luna Blueprints and Code can be obtained as rewards for completing Axion Plains missions.

ㄴ Normal Mission Completion Reward: Research Blueprint Loot A (10% acquisition chance)

ㆍ From Research Blueprint Loot A, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting Ultimate Luna or Snowy Sled Dog.

ㄴ Operational Area Additional Reward: Arche Loot B (5% acquisition chance)

ㆍ From Arche Loot B, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting Ultimate Luna.

- Equipping Luna or Ultimate Luna activates Luna's Descendant Exclusive Quest.

ㄴ Completing Luna's exclusive quest rewards you with the chest attachment Full Moon Symbol.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/70fe7185a05674013bb653a3d494b3e57e127eb4.png"]

ㄴ Operational Area Additional Reward: Snowy Sled Dog Loot (5% acquisition chance)

ㆍ From Snowy Sled Dog Loot, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting Snowy Sled Dog.

ㄴ The stats increase gradually per the growth.

- Item Auto Pickup: Automatically pickup items in the Consumable and Inventory within a certain range.

ㄴ The “item recognition range” increases gradually per the growth.

- Auto-Dismantle Items: Periodically dismantle items that the Descendant acquired. Dismantling is performed when Inventory is full of items.

ㄴ Items for Dismantling are selected per the “Exclude from Junk” setting.

- Auto MP Heal: Automatically recovers Descendant's MP every 45 seconds.

notes.title: Apology and Compensation Announcement for Issues After Season 3 Update
notes.content:
Greetings Descendants. This is The First Descendant Producer Beom-jun Lee.
 

I would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment you experienced due to the recurring issues during the recent Season 3 update. Through today’s announcement, I would like to address the issues related to the "Battle Pass" and "Wall Crasher" content.

 

First, regarding the "Battle Pass," there were continuous errors such as Weekly Challenges not refreshing and abnormal Daily Challenge EXP gains, which directly affected our Descendants' achievements and rewards. This issue arose during our response to Battle Pass errors after the 1.3.1 patch, and it was caused by inadequate handling by the Dev Team and an insufficient QA process. As the person in charge, I would like to apologize once again. We would like to assure you that we are continuously working to resolve the remaining issues.

 

Next, regarding the highly anticipated "Wall Crasher," we identified issues with reward drops at the beginning of the season, as well as unintended gameplay that exploited the party play function. We are currently preparing improvements for these issues.

 

We also humbly accept the feedback that Season 3 content as a whole has not met expectations in terms of stability and completeness. The Dev Team will do their utmost to address the remaining issues with urgency while ensuring the previously announced monthly update plans continue without delay.

 

In addition, the Dev Team aims to pursue more fundamental and sustainable improvements by learning from the issues that have emerged this season.

 

Above all, we plan to establish a more stable development environment by reorganizing inefficient internal processes that have accumulated since launch.

 

Not only will we make short-term efforts to prevent issues through more thorough inspections, but also, in the mid- to long-term, plan to comprehensively review and address problems within our inefficient development processes that have accumulated over time.

 

Through these efforts, we will do our best to develop faster and more stable response capabilities to provide updates that will better satisfy our Descendants.

 

While it may not fully make up for the disappointment our Descendants have felt regarding these issues, we have prepared the following compensation as a token of our sincerest apologies.

 

■ Compensation

- Rewards will be delivered to your mailbox within approximately 10 minutes of logging in on the distribution date specified below.

ㄴ The Battle Pass EXP compensation will not be delivered through the Mailbox but will be automatically applied upon login. If it is not correctly applied, please try logging in again.

- The Mail Expiration Date is 09.10.2025 (Wed) 23:59 PDT. Please make sure to claim your rewards before expiration.

notes.title: Our Sincere Apologies for the TikTok Advertising Issue
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants.
 

We would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment caused by the recent issue regarding the TikTok Creative Challenge.

 

The TikTok Creative Challenge is a program where TikTok creators voluntarily produce and submit content that may be used as advertisements.

 

After confirming with TikTok, we learned that no system currently exists to verify potential copyright infringement, and TikTok is now conducting further investigations to identify any additional cases.

One confirmed case involved unauthorized use of DanieltheDemon’s content by another creator. TikTok identified this as a violation of its guidelines and has already blocked the creator’s account.

 

We would also like to clarify that we do not upload creator advertisement videos as regular posts on The First Descendant’s official TikTok account. Creator advertisement videos are displayed when users access The First Descendant’s official account through advertisements.

In contrast, if the official account is directly searched and visited, these creator advertisement videos are not displayed. This feature was newly implemented by TikTok on August 15 (Friday), and therefore these videos may have appeared as if they were posted and then deleted, but that is not the case.

 

We are taking the TikTok advertisement issue very seriously, recognizing that we failed to uphold the authenticity of our marketing content and to respect the efforts of our creators and community.

 

As a result, we will strengthen our advertising and marketing review processes, including additional review steps with our development team, to ensure that such issues do not recur. We are committed to thoroughly improving our review practices.

 

We will also be committed to continuously being more transparent and responsible to regain the trust of our community and creators.

Once again, we deeply apologize for the disappointment and inconvenience this incident has caused.

 

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Notice Regarding TikTok Creative Challenge Review
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants. 
  
We would like to inform you of certain irregularities identified in the operation of our TikTok Creative Challenge for creators. 

  

As a part of our marketing campaign for Season 3: Breakthrough, we recently ran a Creative Challenge program for TikTok creators, which allows creators to voluntarily submit their content to be used as advertising materials. 

  

All submitted videos are verified through TikTok’s system to check copyright violations before they are approved as advertising content. 

  

However, we have become aware of cases where the circumstances surrounding the production of certain submitted videos appear inappropriate. Thus, we are conducting a thorough joint investigation with TikTok to determine the facts. 

  

We sincerely apologize for the delay in providing this notice as the review is taking longer than expected. Once the verification is complete, we will promptly share an update through an official notice. 

  

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Game Tips for New and Returning Descendants in Season 3
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants!
 

For new and returning Descendants who have joined us after the Season 3 update,

we would like to provide some information to help with gameplay.

 

■ Introducing the "Boost" Event for New/Returning Descendants.

We have prepared the "Boost" Event for Descendants who want to quickly enjoy the latest content.

When you activate "Boost," early main quests (Normal Difficulty Quests) will automatically be completed and Hard Difficulty will be unlocked,

allowing you to start from the Sigma Sector Main Quests in "Season 2 Episode 2 Beyond the Void."

 

Additionally, you can instantly acquire essential items for growth, including the Descendant Bunny, Ultimate Tier Equipment, and Modules.

If you would like to experience the early story, please complete all Normal Difficulty Quests first, then activate "Boost" to receive the essential items.

 

After activating "Boost," you can progress through the "Boost Path" and while completing Path Quests,

which allow you to acquire a range of items including the Descendant Ultimate Bunny and Ultimate Weapons for rapid progression.

■ Want to Stay Up to Date with the Latest The First Descendant News?

notes.title: (Updated) The First Descendant Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
# PDT 2025.08.06(Wed) 23:30 – Fixed incorrect materials requirements for vehicle modification in the table.


Greetings, Descendants!
 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.3.0.

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Update 1.3.0

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/9d73121a360150a3c7b563a959280f744558eb6e.jpg"]Axion Plains

(1) New Battlefield "Axion Plains"

- Accessible via \[Map] - \[World Map], and only available on Hard Difficulty.

- A total of 7 missions, including 2 new mission objectives, have been added to Axion Plains.

- Can be unlocked while progressing through the new Axion Plains main quest.

- The new Axion Plains main quest, which continues the story after the Descendant Corps rescues Dia from Sigma Sector, has been added.

- The Axion Plains main quest consists of 2 parts.

ㄴ Part 1: Available after completing the  zone main quest. It involves a reconnaissance mission in the new Axion Plains.

ㄴ Part 2: Available after reaching Mastery Rank 15 and completing the  main quest. Players are dispatched to the Axion Plains to thwart another Vulgus plot.

- The ‘Legion of Breach’ has been added.

ㄴ Added Named Monsters: Abyss Scarab and Breach Spreader

ㄴ Added Mutants ‘Spikers’: Razor Claw, Steel Pincer, and Breach Discharger.

ㄴ Added 'Breach Creature', ' Breach Follower Soldier', ' Breach follower Sniper', and ' Breach follower Heavy Infantry'

 

(2) Battlefield Missions

- A total of 7 missions, including 2 new missions, have been added to Axion Plains.

- New Missions
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
New Mission: Strategic Asset Defense
[/td][td]
New Mission: Decontamination
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
- This new mission requires you to defend multiple objectives.

- The more successfully you defend objectives, the faster the defense time decreases.

- The mission will fail if you run out of attempts or all defended objectives are destroyed.
[/td][td]
- Decontamination is a new mission where you must defeat enemies to obtain Colossus Organic Samples and maintain a gauge until time runs out.

- Field Data Transmitters are placed on the battlefield where the Decontamination mission takes place, and you can interact with them to interrupt the mission midway.

ㄴ You can't receive any mission completion rewards if you interrupt a mission by interacting with a Field Data Transmitter.

- You can earn Kill Points by defeating Commanders that appear during the mission.

ㄴ You can receive rewards based on Commander Kill Points if you successfully complete a mission or interrupt a mission via interaction with a Field Data Transmitter.

ㆍ Defeating a Commander rewards 30 Void Abyss Metal Fragments and 10 Core Amplifiers.

- The mission will fail if you run out of attempts or the gauge reaches 0.
[/td][/tr][/table]
- Completing an Axion Plains mission will reward you with Descendant EXP, Weapon Proficiency EXP, Ironheart Particles, and Unique Arche Factor EXP. There is also a chance to obtain Blueprint Loot and Trigger Module Loot.

ㄴ From each Blueprint Loot, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting New Descendant: Nell, New Ultimate Weapon: ERASER, or New Vehicle: Orca or Vortex.

ㄴ For each Trigger Module Loot, you can obtain 1 of 9 Trigger Modules.

- Defeating common monsters in the Axion Plains will reward you with Weapon/External Component Augmentation Cores, Core Amplifiers, and Hover Bike Enhancement/Modification materials. There is also a small chance to obtain blueprints for crafting certain Descendants and Weapons.

ㄴ Acquirable Items (Descendants): Lepic, Ajax, Viessa, Valby, Jayber, Kyle, Esiemo, Yujin, Luna, Ultimate Lepic, Ultimate Bunny, Ultimate Viessa, Ultimate Ajax, Ultimate Gley, Ultimate Valby, Ultimate Freyna, Ultimate Sharen

ㄴ Acquirable Items (Weapons): Nazeistra's Devotion, Albion Cavalry Gun, Smithereens, Restored Relic, Greg's Reversed Fate, The Final Masterpiece, Divine Punishment, Piercing Light, Python, Wave of Light, King's Guard Lance, Blue Beetle, Executor, Perforator, Secret Garden, Clairvoyance, Afterglow Sword, Enduring Legacy, Hammer and Anvil

- Defeating special monsters in the Axion Plains will reward you with Standard ETA Vouchers and External Component Augmentation Cores. There is also a small chance of obtaining Crystallization Catalyst blueprints and crafting materials.

- Defeating Commanders in the Axion Plains will reward you with Rare Basic Materials needed to craft New Descendant: Nell, New Ultimate Weapon: ERASER, or New Vehicle: Orca or Vortex.

ㄴ Rare Basic Materials: Entropium, Kerasid, Silentra, Breach Stone Shard

 

(3) Operational Areas

- 2 of the 7 missions in Axion Plains are activated as Operational Areas.

- Operational Areas feature more powerful monsters and offer greater rewards.

- The Operational Area missions change every 2 hours.

- Completing an Operational Area mission will give you the same rewards as for completing an Axion Plains mission, and you can also randomly receive additional rewards.

ㄴ Additional Rewards: Trigger Module Loot, Arche Loot, ERASER Loot, Orca Loot, Vortex Loot

ㆍ From each Arche Loot, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting New Descendant: Nell.

ㆍ From each ERASER Loot, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting New Ultimate Weapon: ERASER.

ㆍ From each Orca Loot, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting New Vehicle: Orca.

ㆍ From each Vortex Loot, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting New Vehicle: Vortex.

ㄴ Additionally, you can obtain Descendant EXP, Weapon Proficiency EXP, Ironheart Particles, and Unique Arche Factor EXP.

 

(4) Dimensional Energy Stabilization

- Clearing an Operational Area increases Dimensional Energy Stabilization Reading.

- Rewards will be given when all Descendants stabilize the Dimensional Energy together.

- Rewards will be mailed to all Descendants who contributed to the Dimensional Energy Stabilization by clearing an Operational Area at least once.

ㄴ 1 Trigger Module Loot

ㄴ 1 Weapon Augmentation Core Box (1 Tier VII Core of every type)

ㄴ 1 External Component Augmentation Core Box (1 Tier VII Core of every type)

ㄴ 60 Specially Treated Alloys, 30 Insulating Nuts, 10 Alloy Bearings, 10 High Conductivity Wires

- Descendants who participated in an Operational Area after the Stabilization can still receive rewards.

- The Dimensional Energy Stabilization status is reset daily.

 

(5) Axion Plains Intercept Battle

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/8687d9d4372405b7eecd5bfc29cf6143b9219455.png"]- Wall Crasher

ㄴ The Wall Crasher is a Colossus with identical Attribute Resistance.

ㄴ The Wall Crasher takes greater damage while it is Dazed after the Void Reflux mode is deactivated.

ㄴ The Wall Crasher periodically creates objects on the battlefield to put pressure on the field.

ㄴ The Wall Crasher attacks slowly, but deals massive damage.

ㄴ A new monster called the Mold, summoned by the Wall Crasher, has been added.

ㄴ Cooperate with your allies in various ways such as using barriers and healing during this first 8-player battle.

ㄴ The Wall Crasher appears every hour on the hour (00 minute) and you must enter the battle within 5 minutes of its appearance.

ㆍ If you fail to enter on time, you can enter by accepting a party invitation from a Descendant who has already entered.

ㆍ Completion rewards can only be claimed once per hour.

ㆍ During the battle, you can also open party recruitment to allow other Descendants to join.

ㄴ During the battle with the Wall Crasher, the mission will not fail even if your personal death count is zero.

ㆍ If your personal death count is 0, the resurrection effect will be partially reduced.

ㄴ Defeating the Wall Crasher grants the following rewards:

ㆍ 4-22 Trigger Module

ㆍ 4 of each \[‘Ballistic Tracker’, ‘Dimension Destroyer’, ‘Circulation’ External Components]

ㆍ 1 of each Tier 8 Weapon Cores

ㆍ 7 of each Tier 10 External Components Cores

ㆍ 50 Core Amplifiers

ㆍ 200,000-300,000 Gold

ㆍ 3,200-4,800 Kuiper Shards

- Field Colossus Battle

ㄴ When the Wall Crasher's precursor animation starts, 2 Colossi are summoned at random locations on the Axion Plains.

ㄴ The Field Colossi remain summoned for 8 minutes and disappear when they are defeated or when the Wall Crasher appears after 8 minutes.

ㄴ The locations of the Field Colossi and their battle expiration times are displayed on the zone map.

ㄴ Defeating the Field Colossi grants the following rewards:

ㆍ 4 Rare Tier Weapons

ㆍ 4 Rare-Ultimate Tier Reactor

ㆍ 3 Rare-Transcendent Tier Modules

ㆍ 8 External Component Sets

ㆍ 200,000-10,000,000 Gold

ㆍ 3,200-4,800 Kuiper Shards

ㆍ Weapons and Descendants’ Codes, Blueprints, and Intermediate Products can be obtained at a low chance.

ㆍ Acquirable Items (Descendants): Lepic, Ajax, Viessa, Valby, Jayber, Kyle, Esiemo, Yujin, Luna, Ultimate Lepic, Ultimate Bunny, Ultimate Viessa, Ultimate Ajax, Ultimate Gley, Ultimate Valby, Ultimate Freyna, Ultimate Sharen

ㆍ Acquirable Items (Weapons): Nazeistra's Devotion, Albion Cavalry Gun, Smithereens, Restored Relic, Greg's Reversed Fate, The Final Masterpiece, Divine Punishment, Piercing Light, Python, Wave of Light, King's Guard Lance, Blue Beetle, Executor, Perforator, Secret Garden, Clairvoyance, Afterglow Sword, Enduring Legacy, Hammer and Anvil

ㆍCrystallization Catalyst, Crystallization Catalyst Blueprint and other materials

 ㆍ Crystallization Catalysts can be obtained at a low chance.

 

(6) Dimensional Breach

- The Dimensional Breach Stabilization Reading increases when the Wall Crasher that appears on the Axion Plains is intercepted.

ㆍ Void Axium mission rewards increased by 3% ~ 30%

ㆍ Research Time decreased by 2% ~ 15%

- Unlocked immediately upon entering the Axion Plains, and there are 6 starting locations.

Arche Trigger System

- Added the new Arche Trigger system.

ㄴ Unlocked by completing the sub quest "Unlock Arche Trigger."

ㆍ This sub quest is available from Mastery Rank 15.

ㄴ After unlocking the system, a new Trigger Module Slot will be added to the Descendant Modules screen.

- The Trigger Module Slot is added for each Descendant and must be unlocked at Prime Hands.

ㄴ The unlocking requirements and cost are as follows:

ㆍ Use Crystallization Catalyst 10 times

ㆍ Use Energy Activator 1 time

ㆍ Reach Arche Tuning Level 40

ㆍ 1 Refined Axium Crystal

ㆍ 300,000 Kuiper Shards

- Selecting the unlocked Trigger Module Slot opens the Trigger Module Settings screen.

ㄴ Alternatively, you can switch to this screen using a shortcut key on the Descendant Modules screen.

- On the Trigger Module Settings screen, you can view your Trigger Modules or use the equip/unequip functions.

ㄴ When a Trigger Module is equipped, the icon of its triggering skill will display a 'glow' effect.

ㆍ This glow effect allows you to check the triggering skill in advance.

ㆍ This display is based on the Descendant's skill tags.

ㄴ After equipping and saving, the triggering skill's icon will be activated and shown.

ㄴ Skill category allows you to view only the Trigger Modules that match a specific skill.

- Trigger Modules that can only be equipped in the Trigger Module Slot will be added.

ㄴ Trigger Modules are modules that trigger an effect when the Descendant uses a skill.

ㆍ Some modules trigger based on the Descendant's skill tags, while others trigger when any skill is used.

- Some Trigger Module options are acquired as random options.

ㄴ There are 3 tiers of random options.

ㆍ There are Common, Rare, and Ultimate tiers.

ㆍ The text color of the option name and values matches the color of the acquired tier.

ㄴ The tier is determined based on the acquired option values.

ㆍ The minimum to maximum values are displayed to the right of the option name.

ㄴ You can also check the tier of an acquired random option through the module icon.

ㄴ You can designate your favorite Trigger Modules.

ㆍ You can only designate your Attached Modules on the Trigger Module Settings screen.

ㆍ Modules designated as Attached are excluded from Trigger Module Dismantling.

- Trigger Modules can be obtained by opening Trigger Module Loot.

ㄴ Trigger Module Loot can be obtained as rewards for Axion Plains missions, additional rewards from Operational Areas, rewards for defeating the Wall Crasher and Dimensional Energy Stabilization Reward.

ㆍ Chance to obtain as rewards for Axion Plains missions: 25%

ㆍ Chance to obtain as additional rewards from Axion Plains Operational Area: 25%

ㆍ Amount obtained as rewards for defeating the Wall Crasher: 4-22

- Trigger Modules use a separate inventory from existing modules.

ㄴ If your Trigger Module inventory is full, you can find them in Lost and Found.

- The Trigger Module Slot is saved together with existing Module loadouts and presets.

- Trigger Modules can be dismantled but cannot be Enhanced or Combined.

ㄴ You can dismantle Trigger Modules via Silion in Albion.

ㆍ Available after completing the sub quest ‘Arche Trigger Unlock’.

ㆍ Dismantling a Trigger Module returns 30,000 Kuiper Shards.

ㄴ You can select all of your Trigger Modules for Dismantling using the Select All button.

ㆍ Equipped or Attached modules are excluded from Dismantling selection.

- Implanting Module Settings includes Implanting the Trigger Module Slot.

- You can check the list of Trigger Modules at the Modules section in the Library.

- Boost can only be activated in Albion, and you can access it via the dedicated button on the Inventory screen.

ㄴ A Level 40 Descendant Bunny with 2 assigned Module Socket Types and increased Max Capacity.

ㄴ An Ultimate Tier Reactor and 4 External Components.

ㄴ Items that maximize Descendant Level and Weapon Proficiency when used.

ㄴ Weapon Attribute ATK can only be defended with ‘Attribute Weapon Resistance’. Skill Attribute ATK can only be defended with ‘Attribute Skill Resistance’.

(3) Target Reward

- Registration of Target Reward unit has been changed from by acquisition source to item.

- When an item is registered as Target Reward, you can accumulate Target Reward Progress in any content that offers the item as a reward.

ㄴ Example

ㆍ Previous: Register "Item A / Void Vessel" as Target Reward > Progress accumulates when playing Void Vessel

ㆍ Changed: Register "Item A" as Target Reward > Progress accumulates when playing any content (e.g., Void Vessel, Intercept Battle, Missions, etc.) that offers the item as a reward

- Target Reward Progress accumulates by 1/n by the number of effective Target Rewards when playing a content.

ㄴ Example

ㆍ If the progress gauge for A and B are 50 and 30, respectively, in a content

ㆍ Previous: Get 50 for A and / 30 for B

ㆍ Changed: Get 25 for A and / 15 for B

 

(4) UI & UX

- Improved the purchase description that is displayed for the selected Descendant or Weapon upon purchasing a Loadout Slot.

ㄴ Previous: Purchases cannot be cancelled once the transaction has been completed.

ㄴ Changed: Expands only the Loadout Slots for the selected \[Descendant] or \[Weapon]. Purchases cannot be cancelled once the transaction has been completed.

- Added filters to search for Weapon Type that meets the Optimization Condition in Reactor Implant Menu.

ㆍ Congas

ㆍ Comic Dance

ㆍ Fantastic Performance

- The Modules section in the Library has been divided into more specific categories.

ㄴ It is now broadly divided into Firearms and Descendants, with additional subcategories added.

ㆍ Firearms - Categorized by Round

ㆍ Descendants - Categorized by Common, Skill/Sub, or Trigger

- Added "Preview in Field" function for Customize - Paint Weapon Skins.

- Added the display image that appears when you attempt to open the map in areas that maps are not available.

 

(5) Sound

- Improved in-game SFX as shown below:

ㄴ Improved gun sounds to add unique shooting experience to each gun.

ㄴ Improved shooting experiences by adding Weak Point Shooting Sound for Colossi.

ㄴ Improved shooting experience by adding Immunity Shooting Sound in Immune situations.

ㄴ Changed the item acquisition sound.

ㆍ Renewed the item acquisition sound to ease the player's auditory fatigue from hearing the same sound repeatedly.

ㄴ Further categorized sound setting items.

ㆍ More detailed options available for the players to adjust SFX, UI, Voice volume, etc., to suit their playstyles.

ㄴ Improved recognition by adding Monster voices for each battle situtation.

ㄴ Improved the sound balance to make Melee Attack sounds more audible.

ㄴ Character-specific interaction dialogues will now be played.

ㆍ Dialogues that show individual character's personality will be played for DBNO interactions.

- Improved in-game music as shown below:

ㄴ Added exclusive music for each Mission in Battlefield.

ㆍ Exclusive Mission music will be played for Basic Missions, Battlefield Missions, and Collection Missions for better immersion.

ㆍ Exclusive music will play during the "Mobile Energy Monitoring" mission in the Axion Plains.

ㄴ Improved Colossus Battles Sounds (including Void Intercept Battles)

ㆍ Each Colossus will have unique music playing.

ㆍ Increased the player immersion by enhancing music that is played at the commencement of Interception and killing of a Colossus.

ㆍ Exclusive notification sound is played when a Colossus is killed to clarify the battle progress.

ㄴ Renewed the Void Erosion Purge music.

ㆍ Added different variants of songs that are easier on ears and played randomly to reduce the players' fatigue in item farming.

ㄴ Improved exclusive music for Descendants.

ㆍ All Descendants music resource has been remastered for quality enhancement.

ㆍ Descendant theme songs are played in loop for enhanced recognition.

ㆍ Improved immersion by having character battle music play only during combat with monsters.

ㄴ All music tracks for Infiltration Operations have been remastered to improve sound quality.

ㄴ Albion's exclusive music has been remastered to improve sound quality.

ㄴ Added music to Laboratory.

 

(6) Other

- Pool decorations in Albion have been removed.

- A “Set Primary Account” feature has been added to the in-game menu.
ㄴ You can access it via ESC > Account > Manage Account Info > Primary Account Setup.
ㄴ If you have linked your account but haven't designated a primary account yet, you can set it upon logging in to the game and start playing.
ㄴ Changing the primary account setting will return you to the title screen.
ㄴ If you set your primary account on the web while the game is running, you must reconnect to the game for the change to take effect.

- Changed the Weapon Core Unlocking condition to reaching Mastery Rank 15.

- Improved to allow Descendant replacement outside the Outpost and Temporary Safe Zone.

ㄴ Replacement is not possible while a Mission is in progress.

- Added "Go to Season 3 Survey" button at the bottom of the Event Screen.

ㄴ You can obtain rewards by participating in the Season 3 survey and submitting your responses through the pop-up that appears after clicking the button.

ㄴ For detailed information about Season 3 Survey period/method/rewards, please refer to the event notice. \[Go to Event Notice]

notes.title: Drop Rate Adjustment for the ‘Grab the Breakthrough’ Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants.

 

We would like to inform you of an adjustment to the drop rates for the ‘Grab the Breakthrough’ event.

 

Due to the high interest in the Acrylic Goods Set and Artbook available through grab tickets, we have confirmed that these rewards are being fully claimed shortly after the daily reset (PDT 00:00).

 

To better accommodate the varied participation times of Descendants, drop rates have been adjusted so that rewards are not limited only to those who participate in the event exactly at the reset time.

 

Please note that the daily limits for physical rewards remain unchanged, and once the set number of rewards is exhausted for the day, they will no longer be obtainable until the next reset.

 

In addition, due to local laws and regulations, delivery of physical rewards may not be available in certain regions. We ask for your understanding.

 

■ Drop Rate Adjustment Schedule
- 2025.07.11(Fri) 00:00 PDT

 

We will continue doing our best to provide an enjoyable event experience for all Descendants.


Thank you.

notes.content:
https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250701/16953cfb-1a5d-4637-a9c8-8ffdc75155f0/250630%EA%B3%B5%EC%A7%80%EB%B0%B0%EB%84%882108x460EN02.png

Greetings, Descendants!

 

The official The First Descendant Companion app has been released, allowing you to continue your Descendant's journey anytime, anywhere.

Check your Descendant information, research status, and event news easily through your mobile device.

 

■ App Release Schedule

- 2025.07.01 (Tue) 00:00 PDT

 

■ App Introduction

- The Companion app is an official app supporting gameplay information for The First Descendant, allowing you to check your owned Descendants, equipped items, and research progress in real-time.

- You can check updated news and announcements, and also enjoy easy access to a variety of web events on your mobile device

 

■ Install Now

- [Google Play] 

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250701/bb2f58fd-310c-4f38-80c0-a9079586e77d/image202507011417396.png

- [App Store] 

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250701/d4d28b17-a1d1-4cea-9c5c-e6cb83bcf67d/image202507011417397.png

■ Key Features

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250701/0e920d7c-9948-40ed-a159-0c6298888165/image202507011417398.png

- Check information on owned Descendants and equipped items

- Check real-time progress of your Item Research

- View item information and ways to obtain them

- Participate in web events on your mobile device

 

 

■ Login and Account Linking

- The Companion app supports login with Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nexon accounts, just like the game.

- Some features like attendance check require logging in with the same account used in the game to participate properly.

 

■ Supported Languages

- The Companion app currently supports Korean, English, and Japanese, with more languages to be added bit by bit in the future.

 

■ Important Notes

※ There may be a short delay before in-game information is reflected in the app.

※ For the reason above, data within the app may differ from real-time information. We appreciate your understanding.

※ Some features may not display properly depending on network status or account linking status.

※ For optimal app performance, we recommend Android 7.0 or higher and iOS 15 or higher.

※ Some app features may be unavailable during game maintenance.

 

 

■ Customer Support

- In-App Path: More > App Info > Customer Service

- Web Customer Service: Link

 

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.21
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants!

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.21, patched maintenance-free.

 

■ Patch Date

- 06.26.2025 (Thu) 00:00 PDT

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Patch Details

(1) Content Improvements

- The placement of the buttons (Select All, Apply, Close) at the bottom in the Descendant selection popup in the Store has been modified for better usability.

- The Shop has been improved to allow purchasing multiple "Attendance Mementos" at once.

- Changed the spray images for "Spring Breeze," "First Snow," and "Artist's Precious Belongings".

 

(2) Bug Fixes

- Updated certain Sub Quest markers from NPCs "Deslin" and "Weapon Workbench" to now display at the "Auxiliary Workbench" and "Core Crafting Bench" NPCs.

- Fixed an issue where the colors of Arche Tuning levels were displaying incorrectly in the HUD.

- Fixed an issue where Sharen and Jayber's metallic jaw cosmetic would appear in the lobby UI regardless of the Descendants unique cosmetics settings when the active customization loadout slot was not slot 1.

- Fixed an issue where after dying with no Rounds left upon reviving the weapon HUD would display Rounds incorrectly.

- Fixed an issue where the shop would appear empty when the "View Only Available Items" option was enabled.

- Fixed an issue where enhancing External Component Cores would complete the "Complete Weapon Core Utilization Training" quest.

- Fixed an issue where the game would occasionally stutter when simultaneously pressing the left and right mouse buttons while adjusting stickers in Photo Mode.

 

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.2.20
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants!

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.20.

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Update 1.2.20

Additional External Component Cores

- "External Component Cores" that enhance the performances of External Components have been added.

- External Components of "Ultimate" Tier or higher have theirs Core unlocked and do not require Core Unlocking.

- You may equip External Component Cores by using Albion's "Core Crafting Bench" once reaching Mastery Rank 8.

- Crafting and conversion of existing Cores are not available at "Core Crafting Bench" once you reach Mastery Rank 8.

- All External Components have two Core Slots and each of them have assigned Augment Types.

ㄴ You can only equip a Core Slot with the same Augment type of External Component Core Items, and options are granted once it's equipped.

ㄴ When an External Component Core is equipped, a random option is granted per the Augment type.

- External Component Core items have stages, marked with Roman numerals (e.g., I, II, III, etc.). The higher the stage, the better the option effect values they provide.

ㄴ Each option has a fixed value range based on the External Component Core item's stage, and the final value is randomly determined within that range.

- An External Component Core that is equipped to a Core Slot may be replaced with another one.

ㄴ To change an External Component Core, a "Core Particle Disruptor" item is required, just as for a Weapon Core.

ㄴ When replacing an External Component Core, you may choose from the existing effects and the new effects. If you do not like the new effects, choose to keep the existing one.

ㄴ If you decide to keep the existing effects, the External Component Core and Core Particle Disruptor spent for the replacement are not returned.

- You may craft External Component Cores at a Core Crafting Bench.

ㄴ To craft an External Component Core, a "Core Amplifier" is needed, just as for a Weapon Core.

- You may convert External Component Cores at a Core Crafting Bench.

ㄴ You may convert Stage 10 External Component Cores, just as for Weapon Cores.

- External Component Core items can be acquired from the "400% Infiltration Operation" and "Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation."

ㄴ Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation Normal Stage 1-8

ㄴ Infiltration Operation: Hard 400% Stage 2-10

ㄴ Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation High-risk Stage 3-10

 

Additional Weapon Core

- "Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)" that can be equipped to a Weapon's Hit Augmentation Slot has been added.

- You can choose to equip or replace the existing "Hit Augmentation Core" or the new "Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)" to the Hit Augmentation Slot.

ㄴ You can replace an existing Core equipped to a slot with a "Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)," and vice versa.

We encourage Descendants who are passionate about The First Descendant to apply and share your valuable insights! Thank you for your interest and support.

notes.title: Content Availability Adjustment Due to Season 3 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants.

 

Due to the rescheduling of the Season 3 update to Thursday, August 7, the availability periods of content originally set to reset or end with the next season will also be adjusted accordingly.

 

Please refer to the details below regarding the content with updated availability periods:

 

■ Battle Pass

- The duration of the Season 2 Episode 2 – “Beyond the Void” Battle Pass will be extended to Thursday, August 7.

- The Bonus Shop will remain accessible until the Season 3 update, and daily challenges will continue to be available.

ㄴ However, please note that no new weekly challenges will be added beyond Week 14.

 

■ Inversion Reinforcement

- The reset schedule for Inversion Reinforcement from Season 2 Episode 2 has been extended to Thursday, August 7.

- As a result, the Collect Ironheart Particles missions for each region will also remain available until the Season 3 update

 

■ Leaderboard

- The reward distribution schedule for the Void Erosion Purge: Challenge leaderboard will also be moved to Thursday, August 7, in line with the extended season duration.

ㄴ However, due to an issue that could affect leaderboard rankings, the leaderboard will be reset during the June 19 (Thu) update as part of the bug fix.

ㄴ Rankings will be based on new records accumulated after the fix on June 19, so we kindly ask for your understanding.

 

■ Void Erosion Purge: Challenge

- The reset schedule for Void Erosion Purge: Challenge corruption purge stages will be extended to Thursday, August 7.

- Accordingly, the reset timing for stage-specific clear rewards will also be adjusted.

 

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the adjustments to content availability due to the update schedule.

As a token of our apology, we have prepared the following compensation:

- The following items will be sent to your in-game mailbox within approximately 10 minutes of logging in during the reward period below.

- Please make sure to claim and use the rewards before they expire on Saturday, September 6, 2025 (PDT) at 23:59.

notes.title: Summary of Dev Live Stream on 6/12 (Thu)
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants!

 

During the June 12th Developer Live Stream, we provided detailed information about upcoming content updates and the direction of future development. 

As we covered a wide range of topics, we have summarized the key information from the broadcast below. For more detailed information, please check the YouTube video.       

https://www.youtube.com/live/USRx4SklFdg
 

■ June 19th Update Introduction

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/2530ba65-3890-499c-9015-23afb49b3d71/image202506121733171.png

- External Component Augmentation Core Added: This update supports Descendant defensive setups, obtainable from 400% Infiltration Operations and Sigma Sector and able to be crafted up to Level 10. Core Slots will start unlocked to prevent excessive time investment. All External Components will have 2 Slots (Recovery/Defense) to maintain set utility across different combinations.

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/44ae25aa-cd04-49bc-97ef-b2175dd16307/image202506121733172.png

- Multi-Hit Core Added: Based on community feedback, the Multi-Hit Core will be added as a Hit Augmentation Core. New Hit Augmentation AB items have been added to allow players to choose between Critical Hit or Multi-Hit setups.

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/995b3f46-5f38-48c8-ab34-5bb9492366dc/image202506121733173.png

- Ice Maiden Challenge Difficulty: Advanced content featuring new Skills and Debuff Immunity Mechanics have been added. First Clear rewards include a large amount of "Quality Certified ETA Vouchers" and a Leaderboard has been added.

- Quality of Life Improvements

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/de825c41-9a1d-4d20-914f-9b80856dfc10/image202506121733174.png

ㄴ Display options for Descendant-exclusive Attachments

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/19ed060f-7f15-4a56-a977-57673df0b744/image202506121733175.png

ㄴ Preset order change feature

ㄴ Intercept Battle Individual Death Count and reduced start waiting time

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/1e64eac4-8a96-450e-909f-e848da09c648/image202506121733176.png

ㄴ Added Photo Mode Frames and Sticker features

 

■ July 3rd Planned Updates

- Erosion Purge Improvements: Stage count reduced from 30 to 10 Stages with Public Matchmaking support for all. The final stage, Stage 10, will feature 5 maps in daily rotation to reduce repetitive play fatigue.

- Core Farming Improvements: Lower-tier Weapon Cores can now be acquired from 400% Infiltration Operations and Sigma Sector, with reduced Crafting/Conversion costs.

- Descendant Balance Adjustments: We will gradually improve Descendants who struggle to perform in their roles in 400% Infiltration Operations, Sigma Sector, Erosion Purges, and Void Intercept Battles. Additionally, Bunny Sprint Speed cap will be increased from 1,300 to 1,600.

- Weapon balance Adjustments: We plan to improve specific Weapon DPS and make adjustments to encourage the use of a wider range of Weapons.

 

■ Skin Updates

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/d1fecfa6-8e6c-495c-8f4a-5a99ff061f94/image202506121733177.png

- On June 19th, the shared dog Fellow costume skin "Furry Companions" will be added.

- On July 3rd, to celebrate the 1st Anniversary and summer, individual summer swimsuit skins will be added, and a massive swimming pool will open in Albion.

 

 

■ Breakthrough Update Preview

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/3395e93e-a718-4f91-91f3-0dd4fada5473/image202506121733178.png

- New Field Axion and Hover Bike: The massive Field, Axion, and quick-moving transportation method, the Hover Bike, will be added. Hover Bikes come in Basic, Balanced, and Acceleration types. When Season 3 begins, you’ll receive one Basic Hover Bike just for logging in, so please stay tuned.

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/01f073a7-2849-4458-8d64-1a1cd8b3fc9f/image202506121733179.png

- Axion Environmental Changes: Like Albion, Axion will feature changing skies based on time of day, along with weather variations such as cloudy and rainy conditions.

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/eb043a38-881d-4adc-86f1-c9b1d5b5aa2f/image2025061217331710.png

- World Boss "Wall Crasher": A Colossus boss that appears in Axion at set times, allowing up to 8 players to participate in real-time. Server-wide rewards that all players can enjoy including reduced Research Time and increased Arche Tuning EXP gains.

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/a6a6c723-7249-414c-b412-a5de05bf3abf/image2025061217331711.png

- Breach Creatures: Controlled by a single host "Cluster Sac," these monsters adapt and evolve based on the attribute they’re attacked with, spawning new Breach Creatures with higher resistance to that attribute. Various strategies, including mixing different attributes, will be required.

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/b2469826-460b-448c-9512-58b5cdbeb2bb/image2025061217331712.png

- Breach Follower: A type of monster that is deployed by Assault Ships. You can prevent their deployment by shooting down the Assault Ships before they land.

https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250612/8e018291-fe6c-48ec-a4ec-7ffe98f4dc50/image2025061217331713.png

- Spiker: Massive variants randomly appear among Common Monsters, adding an element of unpredictability to combat.

 

- Trigger Modules: Consists of effects that automatically activate when using specific types of Skills, enabling new build possibilities.

 

■ Breakthrough Update Roadmap

- August: Season 3 Release, New Descendant "Nell," Axion Field Content

- September: Lounge System, Ultimate Luna Release

- October: Sword Weapons and New Dungeon Added

- November-December: Episode 2 Story, Ultimate Yujin, Ancestors Modules, Module Black Market, etc.

 

■ Event Info

- Pre-registration Event: A wide range of rewards including Ultimate Descendant Ticket when reaching 1 million registrations.

- Events Starting June 19th

ㄴ Burning Summer Attendance: Provides various rewards including the Ines’ Twisted Worship Skin for 6 weeks of attendance.

ㄴ Burning Summer Training: Provides a variety of Growth Items based on Mission completions.

- Events Starting July 3rd

ㄴ Anais 1st Anniversary Gift Workshop: Exchange 1st Anniversary Tokens for Customization and Growth Items.

ㄴ Grab the Breakthrough Web Event: Get 1st Anniversary Tokens through draws, plus Acrylic Merch Sets and Art Books.

- Skin Design Contest: Extended until August 12th. Everyone is welcome to participate, and we look forward to seeing your entries.

 

■ Q&A Key Points

The Q&A session was conducted based on pre-submitted questions. We’re sharing the Dev Team direction and items under internal review across various topics.

- Arche Tuning System: We believe content difficulty and balance adjustments should take priority to prevent Descendant power creep. The system will be expanded gradually depending on future developments.

- Mutant Cells: A variety of types will continue to be added. We’re preparing to expand Mutant Cell farming locations to Axion in Season 3.

- Repeatable Content: Centered on Axion as an all-in-one farming location, we’re preparing elements to add variety to repeated farming through event features like Spiker and Colossus appearances. We aim to gradually improve the system so that most farming can be done through Core Content.

- End Game Content: We will continue to create challenging experiences, including the Ice Maiden Challenge Difficulty coming June 19th, Season 3 Axion, Wall Crasher, and Void Abyss Intercept Battles. 

- Intercept Battle Structure Improvements: We are discussing various improvements, including modifications to the Amorphous Material opening structure and overall enhancements to Hard Intercept Battles. 

- Descendant Balance Direction: We will continue to improve Descendants who are less efficient at eliminating multiple monsters or lack effectiveness in Hunting or Intercept Battles.

- Dia Release Plans: We have no plans to release Dia as a new Descendant this year. We are reviewing a range of ideas for multiple upcoming Descendants, including Dia. 

- AFK Countermeasures: We are operating a separate matchmaking system through accumulated reports and automatic identification. While setting sensitive detection criteria could lead to unfair penalties, we will work to find practical solutions to create a more pleasant gaming experience.

- Community Feedback System: We collect feedback regularly by daily monitoring of overall community reactions. We are also conducting detailed analysis of player drop-off through Focus Group Testing. We are also positively considering implementing an in-game survey system, as requested by many players.

- 400% Infiltration Operation: Rather than modifying this content itself, we are designing Axion as an all-in-one piece of content where all growth and farming is possible, and plan to restructure half-power gameplay around this.  

- Optimization: We are improving various aspects including crash fixes, memory usage optimization, effect optimization, and optimizations related to AI and monsters.

- Dynamic Motion: We have fixed major issues such as costume clipping, excessive movement, and jittering, and are continuing to improve material-specific expressions and motion responses.

 

We hope to repay the loyalty of our Descendants with even higher quality content.

 

Thank you.

notes.title: 2025 Skin Contest Submission Extension & Award Criteria Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants! 

The submission period for the 2025 Skin Contest, which began on May 12 (Mon), has been extended to allow for greater participation and creativity.
We hope this change will give all Descendants more time to finalize and submit their designs.

In addition, the award criteria for Descendant skins have been updated.
Instead of selecting finalists by gender categories (Men / Women / Unisex), all Descendant skin entries will now be reviewed under a unified selection format.
This update aims to reduce the burden on participants and encourage a wider range of creative submissions.

Please note that we have identified several entries that do not follow the official submission guidelines.
To be considered, entries must be submitted using the official template. Submissions consisting solely of screenshots or standalone illustrations without the template will not be eligible for finalist selection.

Please refer to the details below for full information on the schedule changes and award updates.

notes.title: (Updated) The First Descendant Update 1.2.18
notes.content:
[img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250522/986e3492-9b10-4aa7-9a3f-bfb22345f4f9/%EC%97%85%EB%8D%B0%EC%9D%B4%ED%8A%B812108.jpg"] # PDT 2025.07.08(Tue) 02:30 – Mutant Cell > The description of the ‘Defense Neutralization’ effect has been corrected.

# PDT 2025.05.29(THU) 00:00 – Update 1.2.18 >View Descendant: Additional information has been added.  # PDT 2025.05.25 (SUN) 08:00 – Weapon & Module > Bug Fixes: The content regarding the issue of stackable skills not being reset has been revised.  # PDT 2025.05.22 (WED) 01:00 – Update > Arche Tuning Reset Details Modified  # PDT 2025.05.21(WED) 23:00 – The content regarding the PS platform sound output bug fix and the UI&UX option items have been added to the bug fixes.  # PDT 2025.05.21(WED) 22:50 – The content regarding the Dynamic Motion Level has been added.     Greetings, Descendants!      Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.18.     ■ Platforms  - Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5     ■ Update 1.2.18     (Added) Dynamic Motion 

(Added) Dynamic Motion has been added.

ㄴ Dynamic Motion Level has been added. It consists of Weak / Medium / Strong, and the default setting is Medium.  ㄴ Check it in Options > Gameplay > Display Settings.     Arche Tuning  [img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250522/bb636ed1-f45f-47d2-8e37-25868d38556d/1%EC%95%84%EB%A5%B4%EC%BC%80%EC%A1%B0%EC%9C%A8.jpg"] - A new Node is added to Arche Tuning, and "Mutant Cell Slot" is also added.  ㄴ After the 1.2.18 update, all Arche Tuning settings and presets will be reset, excluding the Unique Arche Factor Level and the number of Arche Tunings. Arche Tuning must be reconfigured.  ㄴ After the 1.2.18 update, the following will not be reset: Arche Unique Factor Level, number of Arche Tuning slots owned, Arche Tuning settings, and presets.  - The "Reset" button of the Node has been changed so that you can use Mutant Cell Slot function.

- "Mutant Cell" can be equipped in the Mutant Cell Slot to apply additional effects.  ㄴ Mutant Cell Slot can be activated the same as Normal Node. Activating it does not consume Arche Tuning.  - After activating Mutant Cell Slot, it must be "unlocked" to equip Mutant Cell.  - Each Mutant Cell Slot requires to be unlocked once, and the result will be applied to all loadouts to the unlocked Descendant Group.  ㄴ Unlocking requires 100 Fission Accelerants.  ㄴ Fission Accelerants can be acquired by defeating the commander in Sigma Sector Normal/High-risk Difficulty.  - Equip state of Mutant Cell is not shared among loadouts.  ㄴ For example, Mutant Cell equipped to loadout 1 is saved exclusively in loadout 1, and not equipped to loadout 2 or 3.  - Mutant Cell Slots have Socket Types. Each slot has designated Socket Type that requires Mutant Cells that have the same Socket Types.  ㄴ To change the effect of the equipped Mutant Cell, you must override it with another Mutant Cell.  ㄴ When overrode with another Mutant Cell, the equipped Mutant Cell will perish.  ㄴ Overriding Mutant Cell does not incur any cost.  - Use "Extract" function to retrieve an equipped Mutant Cell.  ㄴ Extraction requires 100 ARC Genetic Scissors.  ㆍ ARC Genetic Scissors can be acquired by defeating the commander in Sigma Sector Normal/High-risk Difficulty.  ㄴ Extracted Mutant Cells are sent to Mutant Cell Inventory and can be equipped in other Mutant Cell Slots.  - When resetting Mutant Cell Slots or all Arche Tuning, the reset will be applied while the equipped Mutant Cells stay as they were.  ㄴ Even if you have a Mutant Cell equipped, if the Mutant Cell Slot itself has been reset, effects will not be applied.  - Mutant Cells can be acquired by opening Spoils Box and selecting the Mutant Cell you wish to acquire.  ㄴ Acquired Mutant Cells can be found in the Mutant Cell Inventory in Arche Tuning Board.  - Spoils Box can be acquired from Sigma Sector Mission completion rewards.  ㄴ Completing High-risk Sigma Sector Mission: 5%  ㄴ Completing Normal Difficulty Sigma Sector Mission: 2.5%  ㄴ Other than Sigma Sector, it can also be acquired by defeating the commander in 400% Infiltration Operation with a low chance.  - A new item "Mutant Cell" has been added.

# Director's Comments

The newly adopted Arche Tuning "Mutant Cell" is designed to enhance the battle efficiency of Skill Dealer Descendants.

However, we do recognize that there is still a performance gap to Firearm Dealers. 
We plan to bridge this gap in a careful and gradual manner, rather than hastily rushing to eliminate it.

"Mutant Cell" is our first step in doing so. We will continue to add more ways to bring the performance difference closer. 
Once the performance gap among Skill dealers has been filled to some extend, we will be adding more Mutant Cells with a wide range effects to diversify gameplay styles.

Also, we are planning an External Components Core Update scheduled for June 19, and it will support the growth of defensive ability of all Descendants.
In addition, it will offer new opportunities for you to set Skill dealer Descendants in more aggressive ways.

We will continue to keep a good balance of the game by encouraging each Descendant to exploit their unique battle styles and advantages.

			 # Director’s Comments 			 Thank you for giving us lots of feedback on potential additions to Multi-Hit Core. 			 We decided on this development based on feedback from players. 			We listened to various opinions on how we should implement the Multi-Hit Chance and Damage stats into the Cores. 			The most popular suggestion was to add them to Special Augmentation, followed by suggestions to put them in Hit Augmentation. 			 We felt it would be more appropriate to include them in the family of Hit Augmentations so that Multi-Hit could become a competitive option alongside Critical Hit. 			However, we also had to consider that increasing the number of Hit Augmentation Core stats to five would make it harder to get the desired stats. 			 Accordingly, we opted to keep the existing Cores unchanged and added a new Hit Augmentation AB Core instead. 			This Core can be equipped in the Hit Augmentation slot, and consists of three stats: Multi-Hit Chance, Multi-Hit Damage, and Weak Point Damage. 			 This update will be rolled out on June 19 together with the External Component Core update, and we’ll continue to closely consider your feedback as we proceed with updates.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.17
notes.content:
PDT 2025.05.15 (Thu) 01:20 – Void Erosion Purge Skill Penalty Patch Update has been revised. 

Greetings, Descendants! 
 
Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.17, patched maintenance-free.
 
■ Patch Date
- 05.14.2025 (Wed) 23:30 PDT
 
■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details 
- Adjusted the difficulty of Void Erosion Purge: Normal (Stages 1–30)
 ㄴ Increased Skill Damage for Descendants.
 ㄴ (Revised) Attribute skill penalties have been removed for all attribute skills except advantageous attributes.
- (Revised) In Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Stages 1–5, attribute skill penalties have been removed for all attribute skills except advantageous attributes.

# Director’s Comment
Following the 1.2.14 update, we took a closer look at gameplay data and found that some skills still had room for improvement.
With this update, we've made adjustments to help more Descendants make better use of their skills across different situations.
We're also introducing the Mutant Cell system in the upcoming 1.2.18 update, which will further enhance skill effectiveness.
We hope you're looking forward to it.

Thank you.

notes.title: Dev Note vol.16│ We’d Like to Hear Your Thoughts on the Multi-Hit Stats
notes.content:
https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250512/64211e11-5550-43d2-83c8-b0d91982c276/DEVNOTE161920.pngGreetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo. 

 

We’re currently seeking your feedback on how to apply the Multi-Hit Chance and Multi-Hit Damage stats for Weapon Core.

 

To expand the build diversity for weapons, we’re preparing to add Multi-Hit Chance and Multi-Hit Damage as new stats to Weapon Readjustment option and Weapon Core.

 

At this stage, we are considering including these two stats as part of the options for the Firepower Augmentation Core.

We hope this change will offer more flexibility when setting up multi-hit weapons.

However, we’re also aware that adding these stats to the existing Firepower Augmentation Core may lower the probability of obtaining other popular options, such as Firearm ATK, which many Descendants currently prefer.

 

To address this concern, we are also exploring the following alternatives:

 

- Separating a new type of core specifically for multi-hit stats from existing cores

- Allowing existing weapons to use the new type of core in Free Slots

- Adding a dedicated slot for the new type of core in future weapons released through upcoming updates

 

As this feature is still in the planning phase, we’re open to a range of possibilities.

We’d like to hear your thoughts so we can move forward in the best direction possible.
