notes.title: Director’s Comment │ Development Status and Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo. 

Lately, you may have found yourself thinking,
“There’s not much to do in the game these days—has development come to a stop?”

It’s completely natural to feel that way during quieter times like this,
and we truly understand and share those concerns.

Right now, our team is fully focused on the development of the Season 3 update.
There were discussions about having smaller and quicker updates in the meantime,
but we ultimately decided that doing so might compromise the quality of Season 3.
Rather than offering temporary fixes, we chose to concentrate our efforts on making Season 3 the best it can be.

However, that doesn’t mean we’re leaving everything else behind while we work on Season 3.
We’ve been reviewing community feedback, addressing issues, and preparing various improvements in order of priority—
and we’re steadily progressing toward the updates scheduled for May 22 and June 19.

Here’s a closer look at what’s coming up:
1.	On Thursday, May 15, we’ll be adjusting the balance for Void Erosion Purge, removing penalties tied to skill attributes.
2.	On Thursday, May 22, we’re introducing updates including Dynamic Motion, the Arche Tuning Socket (officially named Mutant Cell), the new Void Abyss Intercept Battle: Ice Maiden, Party Finder, Core Conversion, and Inversion Reinforcement Presets. A 4-week login event is also planned during this period.
3.	On Thursday, June 19, we’re working on the External Component Core and a long-term login event.
4.	In addition, we’re working to implement a balance patch ahead of Season 3.

The scale of our current updates may feel a bit modest,
but we want to emphasize that each of these steps is part of laying the groundwork for a stronger and more complete Season 3.

We know that no one cares more about the current state of the game than those of you who continue to play our game each day. We’re fully committed to living up to the trust you’ve placed in us.

As always, thank you.

■ (#3) (Resolved) An issue where wing dye is not applied to Serena's Albion Academy Summer Uniform Set.

■ (#3) (Resolved) Issue Where the Descendant Disappears When Entering Photo Mode in Certain Situations
- An issue has been identified where the Descendant disappears from the screen when entering Photo Mode after positioning them against a wall and adjusting the camera so that they are no longer visible.

■ Freyna’s Exclusive Quest Icon Appearing for Other Descendants
- Freyna’s exclusive quest cannot be played with other Descendants and can only be progressed with Freyna or Ultimate Freyna.

■ Intel CPU Issue.
- Crashes have been reported on some Intel 13th and 14th generation CPUs.
- On PCs using these CPUs, the game may forcefully shut down with an error message stating 'Out of video memory' when launched.
This issue can be partially resolved by adjusting power limits in the BIOS.
- We are awaiting a response from Intel regarding this issue, and we are sharing Intel's official response for your reference.
 
■ Temporary solutions for client termination issues with certain antivirus Programs
- We have requested for exceptions for The First Descendant to antivirus programs, but some have not been implemented. Below are temporary solutions for this problem.
(1) ‘Bitdefender’ Temporary Solution [FAQ]
- Go to System Protection > Advanced Threat Detection (ATD) > Manage Exclusions menu, select the file or folder for The First Descendant, and save.
(2) ‘McAfee Agent’ Temporary Solution [FAQ]
- Go to McAfee Security > Navigation > Quarantined and Trusted Items, select TheFirstDescendant.exe from the quarantined programs list, and restore it.

■ Solutions for ‘Easy Anti-Cheat’ not functioning correctly
- If Easy Anti-Cheat malfunctions, refer to the FAQ for solutions. If the issue persists, please contact customer support with relevant screenshots.
- Customer Support Access: Official Website > Customer Support > FAQ > Contact Us

Thank you.

- Added a new Ultimate Descendant, Ultimate Blair.

- Equipping Blair or Ultimate Blair will activate the Descendant Exclusive Quest for Blair.
- Completing Blair's exclusive quest rewards you with the chest attachment Pyromaniac Objet.
Skill Modules
- Skill Module 1: Killer Recipe 
ㄴ Attacking an enemy inflicted with Burn increases your Critical Hit Rate, Critical Hit Damage, and Skill Power to deal damage. Attacking an enemy inflicted with Burn generates Chef's Touch.
ㄴ Fires a meatball forward that explodes on impact, dealing damage and inflicting Burn on enemies.
ㄴ Designates an enemy in front and fires Chef's Touch. It flies in pursuit of the designated enemy and deals damage.
- Skill Module 2: Next-level Recipe
ㄴ Creates a Flame Zone under your feet at certain intervals. Enemies that step on a Flame Zone take damage and are inflicted with Burn.
ㄴ Spurts fire forward. Fire has up to 3 levels, and changes in level when Skill Effect Range reaches a certain value.
ㄴ You can acquire Ultimate Blair's skill modules from Hard Intercept Battles and Module Combine.
Added Ultimate Blair Amorphous Materials
- Amorphous Material Patterns 013, 029, 036, 042, 056, 075, 082, 093-Variant AC, 105, 106, 113-Variant AA, and 115-Variant AA can no longer be acquired.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/2ccade61a3afc154abb09df9e1c9afd814e94925.png
Unlock Requirements
- Unlocks upon clearing Void Erosion Purge: Normal Difficulty .
How to Access
- You can access it via the Infiltration Operations Terminal or the Void Erosion Purge: Challenge icon on the World Map.
How to Play
- Void Erosion Purge: Challenge consists of 5 stages.
- Players start at stage 1 and the rest of the stages are locked.
- After starting Erosion Purge, you'll need to defeat the Vulgus Legion to fill the target gauge. When the gauge is full, the final Commander will appear. Defeat the Commander to complete the Void Erosion Purge.
- Complete Erosion Purge within the target time to unlock the next stage.
Determination of Outcome
- Erosion Purge Complete: If you complete the mission within the target time of 12 minutes, you will receive the mission completion rewards and unlock the next stage.
- Mission Complete: If you complete the mission but exceed the target time of 12 minutes, you will receive the mission completion rewards but the next stage won't be unlocked.
- Mission Failed: If you fail to complete the mission and exceed all 15 minutes of playtime, you will not receive the mission completion rewards and the next stage won't be unlocked.
Rewards
- Only Rounds, MP and HP items drop from the Vulgus Legion that appear, and you cannot obtain other items, Descendant EXP or Firearm Proficiency from defeating them.
- Tier X Cores and Weapon Core Amplifiers are available as one-time rewards the first time you complete the Erosion Purge mission.
Public Operation Availability
- Only "Start Private Operation" is available for all stages 1/2/3/4/5.
Season Reset
The cleared Erosion Purge stages are reset every season episode, allowing you to acquire the First Completion Reward again after the reset.
※ With the addition of the Challenge difficulty, the existing Void Erosion Purge has been renamed to Void Erosion Purge: Normal.

- Added a system that allows enhancing the options of Reactors and External Components.
- Option enhancement can be performed at the workbenches in Albion or outposts.
- The increase in value by enhancing varies for each option.
- When attempting enhancement, there is a small chance of triggering a Critical Success, which increases the option by twice the default increase in value.
- The amount of materials required for option enhancement increases with each attempt.
ㄴ The amount required stays the same after 5 enhancement attempts.
ㄴ Reactor enhancements require Quantum Crystals and Nano Compounds.

- When a skin without wings is equipped, the wings will now only be visible while a skill is used. 
- The skins without wings are as follows:
ㄴ Albion Administrative Support
ㄴ Dandy Corn
- (Updated) Serena's wings no longer appear in Albion.

(3) Weapons & Modules
- Unique Ability enhancement or Core unlocking performed once on a weapon will now apply to all identical weapons.
ㄴ When you have multiple copies of the same weapon, Unique Ability enhancement and/or Core unlocking performed on one copy will apply to the rest of the identical weapons.
ㄴ If you dismantle or sell a weapon with Unique Ability enhancement and/or unlocked Cores and acquire the identical weapon again, it will have the same Unique Ability enhancement and/or unlocked Cores.
ㆍ However, this does not apply to weapons that were removed before the update patch.
ㄴ If you have more than one copy of the same weapon at the time of the patch, their Unique Ability levels will be combined.
ㆍ Ex. If you had one copy of Smithereens with Unique Ability Enhancement Lv. 2 and another copy with Unique Ability Enhancement Lv. 1, both copies will now be at Lv. 3.
ㄴ If you had two or more of the same firearms with unlocked Cores at the time of the patch, you'll receive Core Binders used in excess via in-game mail. [Announcement]
- Firearms with unlocked Core can be dismantled, sold, and used for enhancing Unique Abilities and as materials for Weapon Level Transmission.
ㄴ A warning will be displayed when registering a Firearm equipped with Core as a material for enhancing Unique Abilities or Weapon Level Transmission.
ㄴ A warning will be displayed when selling a Firearm equipped with Core.
- Improved to apply Explosive ATK for Modules that have Firearm ATK Stats from Rare Modules that can be equipped to all High-Power Rounds for Firearms Modules.
ㄴ Items applied with Explosive ATK Stats
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/21c057a79c135275a57a9c8a78fcaeeaea5f0194.png
- Improved Modules that apply both Firearm ATK and Explosive ATK to display Firearm ATK as Firearm (Explosive) ATK.
ㄴ Tooltip Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/cc8fb8a60e241fa9eba8cac152df112ad400557f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/1a7fafa10e3a0de9226311e7a8afb225fc16cec7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/d6b862f3b2aecb2366297cd3482771ab20f86cb0.png

(4) UI & UX
- Changed to fix certain icons of small items to make it easier to get to key UI buttons in some menus when navigating with a gamepad.
ㄴ Readjustment Material Icon in Weapon Readjustment Menu
ㄴ Required Item Icon in Reactor Enhancement Menu
ㄴ Implant Material Icon in Reactor Implant Menu
ㄴ Material Details Icon in Craft Core Menu
- Improved UI to display the current number of Reward Items held when using Selectable Boxes.
- Improved UI to display the number of Paint items acquired.
- Added Craft Core guide.
- Improved the Sort By order for Firearms.
ㄴ Changed to place equipped weapons front.
ㄴ Changed the Sort By list and basic options in Equip Core, Weapon Level Transmission, Weapon Readjustment, and enhance Unique Ability screen.
- Changed to display the calculation method applied (e.g., addition or multiplication) behind the numerical value of the displayed Stats.
ㄴ Unique effect UI for Firearms and (Descendant) Skill Tooltip will be updated at a later time.
ㄴ Applied to: Firearm, Module, Accessory, Inversion, Arche Tuning, Reactor, Random Options, Weapon Core Unlocking

ㄴ Items excluded: Core Tier 1-5, Ultimate Tier Reactor, External Components excluding Ultimate Tier Sets, Ultimate Tier Module
ㄴ Items included: Rare Tier Set External Component
- Effect application rate (%) is added to Boost Item Icon.
ㄴ It can be viewed in Inventory and View Items screen.
- (Updated) In ultra-wide monitor environments, NPC dialogue sequences have been improved to display in the default 16:9 resolution.

(5) Photo Mode
- Added Play/Stop and Play Speed option to Descendants pose change function.
ㄴ You can pause and restart the motion in play.
ㄴ You can change the Play Speed.
ㆍ x 1.0 / x 0.75 / x 0.5 / x 0.25
- Added Filter option.
- Added Slow Move function to Camera.
- Changed the Reset button's input to Hold.
- Activating Hide UI hides the mouse cursor as well.

(6) Miscellaneous
- Changed Item Type Info that was previously displayed only in Single/Group in Emotes Tooltip to be displayed as Emote I Single and Emote I Group.
- Added details to view DPS in Laboratory Damage UI.
ㄴ Max DPS: Displays the maximum value of Damage per second during battle.
ㄴ Avg DPS: Displays the average value of Damage per second during battle. 
- Modified unnecessary descriptions for some of the External Components.
- Changed the number of "Premium ETA Voucher" acquired when selling Ultimate Bunny's "Enhanced Cell Blueprint," "Stabilizer Blueprint," "Spiral Catalyst Blueprint," and "Code" at the ETA-0 Shop from 0 to 3. 
ㄴ Ultimate Bunny Code: 15 → 3
ㄴ Enhanced Cell Blueprint, Stabilizer Blueprint: 10→ 3
ㄴ Spiral Catalyst Blueprint: 5 → 3
- Evolving Skins save Paint information at each of their evolution stage.
ㄴ Paint information set for stage 2 and 3 of Evolving Skin will be reset.
- Vespers Hunting Dog can now equip Fellow Skin's "Gift Supply Hat" and "Gift Supply Cloak."
- Fellow's Back Attachments and Spawn/Despawn Skins are now common skins.
ㄴ Hagios Sheepdog and Vespers Hunting Dog can both equip them.
- Changed the aggregation standards of the "Perform Arche Tuning with any Descendant" condition for Achievements and Battle Pass Challenge.
ㄴ Previously, the highest invested Arche Tuning counts from Descendants were aggregated, but it has been changed to the Tuning counts of all Descendants.
- Lowered the requirement of the Battle Pass Daily Challenge "Grant Me More Strength."
ㄴ Kuiper acquired: 5000 → 1000 
- For the purpose of optimization, some of Monsters' effects have been simplified.
ㄴ Defect Sentry, Defect Scrapheap, Defect Devastator, Fortress Guard, Elite Tracker

- Fixed an issue where sometimes the Immunity of "Immortality Obliviant," a commander monster, is canceled even when all of the monsters it spawned while it had Immunity effect.

ㄴ Now, after the initial hit, if the next target is obscured by terrain, the lightning will return to Ines instead of disappearing.

(3) Weapons & Modules
Fixed an issue where the Reset Cooldown effect of "Veteran's Tactics" Module, one of the Descendant Modules, resets Passive Skill's Cooldown.

notes.title: April 10 (Thu) Dev Livestream Summary
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants. 

We would like to share with you a summary regarding the Dev Livestream which took place today.
We covered various subjects, but mainly focusing on character balancing, new contents and plans for future update.
Please check the video below for more details.
https://www.youtube.com/live/ZIr0qXIbEfU?si=7b0u-ivB0PCmQOOa

■ Character Balancing
- Ines Balance Adjustments
Ines' influence on the game has grown to a point where it restricts the design of combat systems and content. As a result, balance adjustments have been made. Moving forward, we aim to provide clearer and more timely communication regarding the need and direction of such changes.
- Balancing Plans for Serena and Other Descendants
Several Descendants require a rework of their skill sets, rather than mere numerical adjustments. In Serena’s case, we have observed that her in-game performance exceeds our initial intentions and expectations. Nevertheless, given that she is the most recently introduced Descendant, and a relatively short time has passed since her release, we have decided to monitor her performance further before implementing any changes.
- Balancing of Future New Descendants
We acknowledge that newly introduced Descendants with overly powerful abilities have led to ongoing balance issues. Moving forward, we are committed to delivering more carefully balanced content in future updates to ensure a more stable and enjoyable gameplay experience.

■ Content Improvements and System Additions
- Improvements to Void Erosion Purge & Introduction of Challenge Difficulty.
https://youtu.be/OrTkEgvT6O0
We have released a gameplay video highlighting the improvements made to Stage 30 of Void Erosion Purge. Further refinements will be implemented based on community feedback to ensure more engaging experience. For additional information, please refer to [Dev Note vol.15 – Upcoming Improvements to Void Erosion Purge].
In addition, we will be introducing a new high-difficulty feature titled “Challenge Difficulty.” This challenge enables competitive play among Descendants through a dedicated leaderboard. Players who rank within the top 100 for each Descendant will receive exclusive Honor Rewards in recognition of their achievements.
- New System: Medal System
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/930f2ebf34f9119865144802b7d099ddc2377cef.png
A new Medal System will be introduced to visually represent content achievements. Medals can be earned by accomplishing specific achievements, and acquiring the same medal repeatedly will increase its grade and visual design.
- External Component Update Postponed
Due to low necessity in the current content structure, this update has been postponed. Efforts will instead focus on improving the overall quality of Season 3.

■ Ultimate Blair
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/2f25427014ffdcbfa00809b8383c3d5d123914c3.png
A new Ultimate Descendant, Ultimate Blair, will be joining the battlefield.
Along with his release, a new story episode will be added—unveiling the journey of how Blair gains his ‘Ultimate’ power.
This episode captures Blair’s romantic and comedic charm, so we hope you're as excited as we are to experience his unique flair!

■ New External Components & Modules
A total of five new External Component sets and two new Modules will be introduced, offering greater build diversity and enabling more specialized role-based configurations.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/0b9fd1b001890649fe32b59e4ad72c4636098a07.png
In addition, we are pleased to introduce the Reactor and External Component Enhancement System. This new feature allows players to gradually enhance option stats by utilizing specific materials. With consistent effort, all players will be able to work toward and achieve their ideal setups through dedicated gameplay.

■ Improvements to User-Friendly Features & Support for New Players
- Reward Enhancements
The Void Shard cost will be removed when opening Amorphous Materials at the Void Fusion Reactor. Additionally, Unique Arche Factor EXP rewards will be added to Hard difficulty Special Operations, and overall rewards in the Sigma Sector will be improved.
- Weapon Research Improvements
When crafting duplicate weapons, the unique effect will consistently be set to the highest tier. Furthermore, unlocking the core of duplicate weapons will be required only once. For players who have already unlocked multiple duplicates, Core Binders will be returned accordingly. More detailed information will be provided in future notice.
- Beginner’s Guide 
Beginner’s guides will be introduced to help players advance more smoothly through the main storyline while naturally learning key gameplay systems. The structure of the main questline will also be simplified, allowing players to select and prioritize missions based on their preferences.
- Mission Structure Revisions
Key missions in Kingston and Sterile Land will be redesigned to emphasize combat-focused gameplay. Field missions such as Occupations and Destroy Kuiper will require fewer repetitions or less time to complete. In addition, Ultimate Bunny can be obtained through missions on Normal difficulty.

■ New Skins
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/c09a994eb47f407368713cd5c6c2c6144a55530f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/f07e10614b59b0a6b8e55dd6d7f822cf0f40e886.png
On April 17, a new universal skin, “Dandy Corn,” will be added. 
On April 30, the “Albion Academy Cadet” series for female Descendants will be updated.

■ In-Game Event Announcement
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/f14f7a4c9e1abdba136e625b6a94e9dd3478cb97.png
A 5-week period in-game event will begin on April 17, consisting of daily and weekly missions. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/c72d2700d7f6a464fccc29563974ff9044a04c8c.png
Also, everyone who logs in between April 17 to 24 will receive a “Surprise Egg” social motion as a gift!

■ May Update Preview
Dynamic Motion, Arche Tuning: Socket System, Void Abyss Intercept Battle: Ice Maiden, Special Operations - Hard difficulty (Echo Swamp/Sterile Land), Party Finding System, view other Descendants' Stats, Core Convert Feature and other more updates.

■ PAX East 2025 Participation
On Sunday, May 11 at 12 PM (EST), we’ll be appearing on the main stage of PAX East 2025.
You’ll get a first look at Season 3 content and see cosplay of Bunny and Serena.
Check the [PAX East Participation Notice] for full details.
 
Thank you.

■ (#5) (Resolved) Issue where the 'Show Skill Cooldown' option setting is reset upon exiting the game 
- We have identified an issue where the 'Skill Cooldown' option in Options > Gameplay is changed to 'Off' when exiting the game, even if it was set to 'On'. 

■ (#5) (Resolved) Issue where the accumulated playtime for the 'Ingris Guardian Blair' event is intermittently reset upon game reconnection. 
- The issue where the accumulated playtime for the 'Ingris Guardian Blair' event is intermittently reset upon game reconnection has been identified. 


[April 17th]
■ (#4) (Resolved) Game closes when clicking the "Cancel" button while switching tabs in the Shop's Recommended section

■ (#4) (Resolved) Icons for the “Ultimate Blair Spiral Catalyst” and “Ultimate Blair Spiral Catalyst Blueprint” items are swapped.
 

[April 3rd]
■ (#3) (Resolved) Issue where Ines’s “Chain Lightning” and “Floating Lightning” skills cannot hit certain objects

■ (#3) (Resolved) Incorrect display of item acquisition sources in ‘Special Operations’
- We have identified an issue where the acquisition sources of items obtainable through ‘Special Operations’ are displayed incorrectly when checked via the ‘Library’.

 

[Previous Known Issues] 

■ Issue Where the Descendant Disappears When Entering Photo Mode in Certain Situations 

- An issue has been identified where the Descendant disappears from the screen when entering Photo Mode after positioning them against a wall and adjusting the camera so that they are no longer visible. 

 

■ (#3) (Resolved) Incorrect Description of Auto Refill Rounds for Vespers Hunting Dog in Languages Other than Korean and English 

- An issue has been identified where the Auto Refill Rounds effect for Vespers Hunting Dog was incorrectly described in languages other than Korean and English. 

- The description mistakenly stated that the effect applies to the “equipped weapon” instead of the “currently using weapon.” 

 

■ (#5) (Resolved) Issue Where Incorrect Fellow is Displayed in the Fellow Spawn Tooltip 

- An issue has been identified where the tooltip for the Fellow Spawn item incorrectly indicates that only Hagios Sheepdog can be equipped. 

- Please note that both Hagios Sheepdog and Vespers Hunting Dog can equip the Fellow spawn item. 

 

■ Freyna’s Exclusive Quest Icon Appearing for Other Descendants 

- Freyna’s exclusive quest cannot be played with other Descendants and can only be progressed with Freyna or Ultimate Freyna. 

 

■ (#5) (Resolved) [PS][XBOX] Display of the Top Menu When Clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ or ‘Content Creator’ Buttons to Navigate to the Homepage 

- On the ‘PS’ and ‘XBOX’ platforms, clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ or ‘Content Creator’ buttons to navigate to the homepage results in the top menu being displayed. 

- Please note that, while navigation to other pages within the homepage is possible, actions such as ‘Login,’ ‘Start Game,’ and ‘Enter Coupon’ cannot be performed due to this issue. 

 

■ (#5) (Resolved) [PS4] Voice Chat Issue When Creating a Party on PS4 Platform 

- It has been identified that voice chat does not function properly when creating a party on the PS4 platform. 

 

■ Intel CPU Issue. 

- Crashes have been reported on some Intel 13th and 14th generation CPUs. 

- On PCs using these CPUs, the game may forcefully shut down with an error message stating 'Out of video memory' when launched. 

This issue can be partially resolved by adjusting power limits in the BIOS. 

- We are awaiting a response from Intel regarding this issue, and we are sharing Intel's official response for your reference. 

  

■ Temporary solutions for client termination issues with certain antivirus Programs 

- We have requested for exceptions for The First Descendant to antivirus programs, but some have not been implemented. Below are temporary solutions for this problem. 

(1) ‘Bitdefender’ Temporary Solution [FAQ] 

- Go to System Protection > Advanced Threat Detection (ATD) > Manage Exclusions menu, select the file or folder for The First Descendant, and save. 

(2) ‘McAfee Agent’ Temporary Solution [FAQ] 

- Go to McAfee Security > Navigation > Quarantined and Trusted Items, select TheFirstDescendant.exe from the quarantined programs list, and restore it. 

 

■ Solutions for ‘Easy Anti-Cheat’ not functioning correctly 

- If Easy Anti-Cheat malfunctions, refer to the FAQ for solutions. If the issue persists, please contact customer support with relevant screenshots. 

- Customer Support Access: Official Website > Customer Support > FAQ > Contact Us 

  

Thank you.

Content Improvements

Bug Fixes
(1) Content

(2) Weapons & Modules 
- Fixed an issue where weapon readjustment could produce values slightly outside the weapon's option range. 

(3) UI & UX
- Fixed an issue where the Help for module slots of normal Descendants and Ultimate Descendants was shown combined in the Implant Module UI.
- Fixed an issue where it was not possible to select a different Void Erosion Purge stage after clicking 'Start Public Operation' for a Void Erosion Purge.
- Fixed an issue where it was not possible to select the Selectable Reward or Kill Score Multiplier of another Infiltration Operation after clicking 'Start Public Operation' for an Infiltration Operation.

(4) Other 
- Fixed an issue where the Descendant's hand would appear unnatural when equipped with The Last Dagger's weapon skin, Dark Nebula.

- Fixed an issue where objects summoned during missions could not be damaged with launcher weapons.
- Fixed an issue where the wings on Serena's "Albion Administrative Support" body skin were not affected by paint.


# Director's Comments
Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.

The balance between Descendants has been an important topic of discussion in the community.
Recently, successive releases of new overpowered Descendants such as Ines and Serena have caused some content being cleared way more easily than intended. We're taking this trend seriously, and this rebalance is our first step toward addressing the problem.
 
This rebalance focused on strengthening relatively underperforming Descendants, using as basis the performance of Viessa, Valby, and Hailey, who are the current baseline. However, we recognize that for some Descendants, simply tweaking some numbers are not enough to bring out the best in them. We believe that the mechanics of certain skills may need to be reworked to achieve more meaningful performance improvements, but we had to adjust multiple Descendants simultaneously and we apologize for focusing on numerical balancing this time. We understand that you may find some changes inadequate because of that, but we'll continue to review and implement improvements to skill structure and design.

Conversely, we determined that some of the Descendants whose performance significantly exceeded the baseline and could impact content structure needed adjustments. Ines is a prime example of this and her performance is significantly above the baseline, so we made some adjustments in this patch. Freyna's performance is also above the baseline, but not so much that it breaks the flow of the content, so we've put the adjustments on hold. Serena is a firearm-based dealer who we believe is currently significantly exceeding the baseline, but since she hasn't been released for long, we'd like to see more data before deciding on how to respond.
 
We don't believe we can balance all the Descendants perfectly with this single patch. We'll continue to closely analyze post-patch data and make further adjustments to Descendants that fall short of the baseline or are overperforming based on community feedback. We'll also finetune Serena's performance along the way.
 
We're also keenly aware that we've been releasing new Descendants in an overpowered state. While the Dev Team does hope for the new Descendants to be in the spotlight, we don't want them to be released overpowered to the point of breaking down the content structure. We're looking internally at the reasons for this recurring issue, and we're working to improve our development process so that we can deliver more stable and balanced content in the future.
 
We're deeply grateful to all the players for their continued heartfelt feedback on The First Descendant. We consider this rebalance a step towards further refining the balance, and we'll continue to make adjustments and improvements based on play data, and do our best to provide a better gaming experience.
 
Additionally, in response to community feedback, we are currently working on improving Serena's wings so that they are no longer visible when she equips a common skin. The wings will only be displayed when she uses her skills, and this change will be implemented in the April 17 patch.


Thank you.

Greetings, Descendants. 

 
Here are the major issues that were found for The First Descendant in March. 


We will continually update this notice with any additional issues and bugs that are found, as well as any impactful issues identified before February. Please keep track of the updates during your gameplay. 


[March 27th] 

■ (#8) Issue Where Wing Dye Is Not Applied to Serena’s “Albion Administrative Support” Body Skin


[March 20th] 

■ (#7) (Resolved) Issue in the Invasion Mission where Order of Truth enemies appear 
- We have identified an issue where all Descendants are eliminated upon interacting with drones that match the Arche Trait during the Invasion mission where Order of Truth enemies appear, making it impossible to progress. 

- Once the cause is identified, we will work to resolve this issue as quickly as possible. 

■ (#8) (Resolved) Issue with the ‘General Round: Heat Circulation' Module Being Limited to Handguns 

- It has been identified that the 'General Round: Heat Circulation' module is currently set to be equipped only on handguns. 

- Please note that this module will be adjusted in the upcoming Hotfix 1.2.12 patch to be usable with other general round weapons as well. 

 
■ (#8) (Resolved) Issue with Abnormal Display When Purchasing Individual Paints via the 'View Related Products' Button in the Store 

- An issue has been identified where the screen displays abnormally when purchasing individual paints after clicking the 'View Related Products' button on paint bundle components in the store. 

Please note that this issue will be fixed in the upcoming Hotfix 1.2.12 patch. 
 


[March 13th] 

■ (#2) (Resolved) Issue where the UI completion indicator resets when completing the daily mission of the ‘Assist with Serena's Covert Operations’ event 

- It has been confirmed that the UI completion indicator resets when moving to a different area after completing the daily mission of the ‘Assist with Serena's Covert Operations’ event. 

- Please note that due to this issue, the mission completion indicator will not count further, and rewards cannot be claimed multiple times. 

■ (#3) (Resolved) Issue where monsters spawn in the air intermittently
- It has been confirmed that during missions, monsters intermittently spawn in the air.

■ (#3) (Resolved) [Event] Issue with Missing Notification When Exceeding Purchase Limits in the Operation Support Shop 

- An issue has been identified where no notification is displayed when attempting to purchase an item beyond its purchase limit in the Operation Support Shop. 

- While the notification does not appear, please note that purchases exceeding the set limit cannot be completed. 

- This issue will be fixed in Hotfix 1.2.11, ensuring the notification is displayed properly. 

 

■ Issue Where the Descendant Disappears When Entering Photo Mode in Certain Situations 

- An issue has been identified where the Descendant disappears from the screen when entering Photo Mode after positioning them against a wall and adjusting the camera so that they are no longer visible. 

 

■ Incorrect Description of Auto Refill Rounds for Vespers Hunting Dog in Languages Other than Korean and English 

- An issue has been identified where the Auto Refill Rounds effect for Vespers Hunting Dog was incorrectly described in languages other than Korean and English. 

- The description mistakenly stated that the effect applies to the “equipped weapon” instead of the “currently using weapon.” 

 

■ Issue Where Incorrect Fellow is Displayed in the Fellow Spawn Tooltip 

- An issue has been identified where the tooltip for the Fellow Spawn item incorrectly indicates that only Hagios Sheepdog can be equipped. 

- Please note that both Hagios Sheepdog and Vespers Hunting Dog can equip the Fellow spawn item. 

 

■ (#3) (Resolved) Issue Where MP Collector Module Effect Occasionally Fails to Activate 

 

■ (#3) (Resolved) Issue where preview of spray rewards obtainable from the Battle Pass is displayed as social motion 

 

- It has been confirmed that the preview of spray rewards obtainable from the Battle Pass is displayed as the preview of the last checked social motion. 

 

■ (#2) (Resolved) Issue where players do not respawn correctly on the ground when falling below the surface after defeating the 'Tormentor' in the Void Intercept Battle(Abyss). 

 

■ (#2) (Resolved) An issue where clicking the '+' button displayed in the Caliber possession details does not navigate to the Caliber purchase screen. 

 

(Only Eu region) 

■ (#3) (Resolved) Issue where the probability information page is not displayed when clicking the 'View Probability' button in European countries.

- It has been confirmed that the probability information page is not displayed when clicking the 'View Probability' button in European countries. 

- Please note that this issue is scheduled to be fixed in the Hotfix 1.2.11 patch. 

 

 

 

 

[Previous Known Issues] 

■ Freyna’s Exclusive Quest Icon Appearing for Other Descendants 

- Freyna’s exclusive quest cannot be played with other Descendants and can only be progressed with Freyna or Ultimate Freyna. 

 

■ [PS][XBOX] Display of the Top Menu When Clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ or ‘Content Creator’ Buttons to Navigate to the Homepage 

- On the ‘PS’ and ‘XBOX’ platforms, clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ or ‘Content Creator’ buttons to navigate to the homepage results in the top menu being displayed. 

- Please note that, while navigation to other pages within the homepage is possible, actions such as ‘Login,’ ‘Start Game,’ and ‘Enter Coupon’ cannot be performed due to this issue. 

 

■ [PS5] Voice Chat Issue When Creating a Party on PS4 Platform 

- It has been identified that voice chat does not function properly when creating a party on the PS4 platform. 

 

■ Intel CPU Issue. 

- Crashes have been reported on some Intel 13th and 14th generation CPUs. 

- On PCs using these CPUs, the game may forcefully shut down with an error message stating 'Out of video memory' when launched. 

This issue can be partially resolved by adjusting power limits in the BIOS. 

- We are awaiting a response from Intel regarding this issue, and we are sharing Intel's official response for your reference. 

  

■ Temporary solutions for client termination issues with certain antivirus Programs 

- We have requested for exceptions for The First Descendant to antivirus programs, but some have not been implemented. Below are temporary solutions for this problem. 

(1) ‘Bitdefender’ Temporary Solution [FAQ] 

- Go to System Protection > Advanced Threat Detection (ATD) > Manage Exclusions menu, select the file or folder for The First Descendant, and save. 

(2) ‘McAfee Agent’ Temporary Solution [FAQ] 

- Go to McAfee Security > Navigation > Quarantined and Trusted Items, select TheFirstDescendant.exe from the quarantined programs list, and restore it. 

  

■ Solutions for ‘Easy Anti-Cheat’ not functioning correctly 

- If Easy Anti-Cheat malfunctions, refer to the FAQ for solutions. If the issue persists, please contact customer support with relevant screenshots. 

- Customer Support Access: Official Website > Customer Support > FAQ > Contact Us 

  

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.2.10
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants! 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.10.
You can also check out the update details on Season 2: Beyond the Void page! [Link]


■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Update 1.2.10

Main Quest: Sigma Sector
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/2e5e2245dcb2308c9d6d3b725cc33b3c8e871a72.jpg

- Added the  main quest, which takes place after the Descendant Corps destroyed the first Ironheart.
ㄴ The  main quest is available after completing the  zone main quest.
ㄴ During the , completing the  allows you to check the  in a record.
ㄴ If you investigate all traces of the Early Descendants listed in this record, you will receive a special Chest Attachment.

New Content: Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation
- Sigma Sector has been restricted for a century due to the strong Void Erosion phenomena there. In a land where nothing was thought to survive, now traces of the enemy have been found.  
Penetrate the powerful Void Storm and find out what's going on in Sigma Sector.
- Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation becomes available after completing the main quest 'Responsibility, Regret, and Atonement.'
- The features of Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation are as follows:
ㄴ A new field, Sigma Sector, is added.
ㄴ Sigma Sector features a new type of monsters from the Legion of Immortality, the Defects. 
ㄴ Sigma Sector consists of two zones, Broken Boundary and Isolated Desert, with two difficulty levels, Normal and High-risk, based on the Storm Level.
ㄴ One of the four missions for each zone and difficulty level is randomly selected and carried out.
ㄴ Reaching Mastery Rank 15 and completing an Isolated Desert mission unlocks Broken Boundary on High-risk Difficulty.
ㄴ Completing a Broken Boundary mission on High-risk Difficulty unlocks Isolated Desert on High-risk Difficulty.
ㄴ Defeating certain monsters in Sigma Sector will drop Sigma Sector exclusive unique weapons, Ground Custodian.
ㄴ When you acquire a Ground Sweeper, you can deal more damage to enemies or destroy the enemy's giant transport ships more effectively. 
- During the Sigma Sector main quest, you can earn the following rewards that will help your Descendant:
ㄴ Upon completing ‘Operation Unbelievable’: 1 Energy Activator, Nimble Fingers +5, Skill Expansion +5, HP Amplification +5
ㄴ Upon completing ‘Ultimate Troublemaker’: Electric Condense +5, Focus on Electric +5, Focus on Singular +5
ㄴ Upon completing ‘Fix What We Broke’: Contagion +5, Focus on Toxic +5, Focus on Tech +5

High-Value Relic Exchange 
- You can visit Reina in Albion to exchange High-Value Relics obtained from Sigma Sector Dropoff Operations for various items.
ㄴ Unlocked when you reach Mastery Rank 15 and complete an ‘Isolated Desert’ mission.
How to obtain High-Value Relics
- Today's Bonus is available once a day per zone in the Sigma Sector on High-risk Difficulty.
- You can obtain 1 High-Value Relic for today's bonus, with a maximum of 2 per day.
- Today's Bonus rewards become available when you unlock the Arche Tuning System.
Exchangeable Items
- Unique Arche Factor EXP Boost 15% (1-Hour)
- Unique Arche Factor EXP Boost 15% (5-Hours)
- Unique Arche Factor EXP Boost 15% (3-Days)
- Equipment Slots +1 (Purchase limit of 100)
- Storage Slots +1 (Purchase limit of 100)


New Descendant: Serena
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/e76649c936b9c9d91f3718bdd8456d7a9b502de0.png
- Added a new Descendant, Serena Antonietta.
ㄴ You can acquire Serena's blueprints, codes and materials from Sigma Sector Dropoff Operations.
Serena's Skills
- Passive: Divinity
ㄴ Serena receives bonus stats when in midair.
- Active 1: Sacred Flame
ㄴ Fires flames in the direction of the crosshair, dealing damage and inflicting Repentance on enemies and granting Blessing to allies.
ㄴ Penetrates terrain when used on the ground and explodes on contact with the ground when used in midair.
ㄴ Repentance deals continuous damage and reduces the enemy's Fire Resistance, and firearm attacks against enemies inflicted with Repentance have a chance to recover Rounds for the firearm in use.
ㄴ Blessing heals Serena for a percentage of her Max HP every second.
- Active 2: Ascension
ㄴ A toggle skill that drastically reduces gravity when used and grants various effects depending on the Rounds when attacking with a firearm in midair.
ㄴ However, using it adjusts the Grappling Hook cooldown and Jump.
ㄴ General Rounds: Increases Multi-Hit Chance and Multi-Hit Damage.
ㄴ Special Rounds: Deals AoE firearm damage to nearby targets based on the firearm damage dealt.
ㄴ Impact Rounds: Recovers MP on a critical hit.
ㄴ High-Power Rounds: Has a chance to deal additional Fire skill damage.
- Active 3: Soar
ㄴ When used on the ground, Serena soars high into the air. When used in midair, she moves quickly in the input direction.
ㄴ When used in midair, holding down the skill key makes her move for a certain period of time.
ㄴ Additionally, using the skill reloads the currently equipped weapon and resets the number of her Jumps.
- Active 4: Redemption
ㄴ When used on the ground, grants Prayer of Redemption to Serena and nearby allies.
ㄴ When used in midair, grants Redemption's Judgment to Serena.
ㄴ Prayer of Redemption significantly reduces incoming damage for a certain number of hits, and recovers HP and MP when the effect is removed.
ㄴ Redemption's Judgment deals powerful additional AoE damage to the surrounding area based on Serena's HP when she attacks with a firearm.
Skill Modules
- Skill Module 1: Divine Surge (Active 4)
ㄴ Quickly flies forward and inflicts Knockdown on collision, and deals large amounts of damage on landing.
ㄴ Creates Purifying Blaze along the path and inflicts Repentance on targets hit.
ㄴ Repentance deals continuous damage and reduces the enemy's Fire Resistance, and firearm attacks against enemies inflicted with Repentance have a chance to recover Rounds for the firearm in use.
ㄴ When used in midair, the angle of movement is adjusted in the direction of the crosshair.
- Skill Module 2: Hymn (Active 3)
ㄴ When used on the ground, Serena soars high into the air and leaves a Hymn of Exaltation on the ground, which increases the Jump of all allies within range.
ㄴ When used in midair, Serena moves and grants Hymn of Vitality to nearby allies, increasing their Movement Speed.
ㄴ Additionally, using the skill reloads the currently equipped weapon and resets the number of her Jumps.

External Components
- Added new External Components.
- New External Components can be obtained from Sigma Sector
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/c8790718c5cc1d68ac57c6f0e66bae0bf642ad37.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/72bfe3b942af0adf0f8206deee53a9a4c1126213.png

Module Settings Implant System
- Added the Module Settings Implant System, which allows the transfer of Module Settings applied to the Normal Descendant to the Ultimate Descendant.
- Transferring to the Ultimate Descendant requires the Photonic Implanter. 
- The Max Capacity UP and assigned Module Socket Types of the Normal Descendant can be transferred to the Ultimate Descendant as is.
ㄴ This means that both Energy Activator and Crystallization Catalyst applications are transferable.
ㄴ However, the assigned Socket Type is implanted into the same slot position, and the initial Module type of a standard Descendant is not implanted.
- After the implant, the Normal Descendant loses the Max Capacity UP and assigned Module Socket Types.
ㄴ However, any duplicate Max Capacity UP and assigned Module Socket Types applied to both Normal and Ultimate are returned as Consumables.

Arche Tuning System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/64fbeb647ad400ea667492541f2e70fda9bfd121.jpg
- Added the Arche Tuning System that enhances your Descendant's abilities. 
- The system unlocks when you complete the main quest 'Into the Storm.'
ㄴ A sub quest is available to help you understand the Arche Tuning features.
- Using the system requires Arche Tuning, which is acquired when your Unique Arche Factor level increases.
- You can increase your Unique Arche Factor level by obtaining and accumulating.
- Unique Arche Factor EXP can be obtained from various content.
Where to Obtain Unique Arche Factor EXP
ㄴ Normal Sigma Sector
ㄴ High-risk Sigma Sector
ㄴ Mission of the Day: High-risk Sigma Sector
ㄴ Void Erosion
ㄴ Void Vessel: Hard
ㄴ 400% Infiltration Operation 
- You can access the Arche Tuning System via the menu in the Inventory or at the Prime Hands.
- The Arche Tuning status is shared per Descendant Group, and the effects are also applied equally.
ㄴ Only the same Descendants (Normal, Ultimate) are treated as a single Descendant Group.
ㄴ For a Descendant Group with only the Normal Descendant, both the Normal and Ultimate will be treated as a single Descendant Group when the Ultimate is added later.
- Arche Tuning consists of multiple Nodes.
ㄴ Each Node has a Tier, and the value of a Node's applied effect is dependent on its Tier.
ㄴ Nodes require Arche Tuning to activate, and cannot be activated without it.
- You can start activating Nodes that are closest to the Tuning Starting Point.
ㄴ The Nodes that can be activated are applied with a separate effect, allowing you to discern which Nodes can be activated. 
ㄴ You can only activate Nodes that are adjacent to an activated Node.
- Activated Nodes can be reset.
ㄴ You can reset each individual Node, or all Nodes at once through Full Reset.
ㄴ Resetting returns the Arche Tuning used for activation.
- Loadouts and Presets are available.
ㄴ A total of three loadout slots are provided.
ㄴ Added a dedicated slot for Arche Tuning within Presets.
ㄴ Saved as a loadout activated at the time Preset was saved.

Special Operation Hard Difficulty Map Changes
- The map for Special Operation Hard Difficulty has been updated.  
ㄴ Resource Defense: Echo Swamp → Fortress  
ㄴ Mine Blockade: The Sterile Land → White-night Gulch  
- The EXP granted in each middle section of Special Operations on Hard Difficulty has been removed or reduced, and the same amount has been added to the EXP rewards for defeating monsters in each wave.  
- The chances of earning rewards for defeating monsters have been adjusted due to the change in the number of monsters.  
ㄴ The total EXP earned remains the same or is slightly higher than before.

Content Leaderboards
- Added a leaderboard to Void Intercept Battle (Abyss).
ㄴ You can check it on the Intercept Start screen and the Results screen of Void Intercept Battle (Abyss).
ㄴ The Void Intercept Battle (Abyss) Leaderboard ranks players by clear time.
ㄴ The Void Intercept Battle (Abyss) Leaderboard will be reset as follows:
ㆍ Reset start time: UTC+0 2025.03.13 (Thu) 07:30 ~ 2025.04.17 (Thu) 07:30
ㆍ Reset cycle: 10 weeks (70 days)
ㄴ The reset cycle for the Void Erosion Purge Leaderboard will change as follows:
ㆍ Reset start time: UTC+0 2025.03.13 (Thu) 07:30 ~ 2025.04.17 (Thu) 07:30
ㆍ Reset cycle: 5 weeks (35 days)

Four New Ultimate Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/ad6b8e787d293705cade894becb4c87fa382930d.png
(1) Malevolent (Hand Cannon)
- Acquirable from Battle Pass.
- Unique Ability: Malicious Pain
ㄴ Hitting an enemy creates a Bladed Cog.
ㄴ The Bladed Cog bounces between multiple enemies, dealing damage.
ㄴ Hitting a Weak Point creates additional Bladed Cogs.
(2) Truly Deadly Arson (Beam Rifle)
- Blueprints, codes, and materials can be obtained in Sigma Sector (Normal)
- Unique Ability: Double Tap, Double Check
ㄴ Hitting an enemy inflicts Void Fire.
ㄴ When a Burn-related effect is inflicted, Void Fire explodes, dealing damage and transforming Burn to a more powerful effect, Inferno.
ㄴ Inferno nullifies Void Fire.
ㄴ Only Fire ATK applies to this weapon.
ㄴ Other Attribute ATKs are converted to Fire ATK at a certain ratio.
(3) Ancient Knight (Assault Rifle)
- Blueprints, codes, and materials can be obtained in Sigma Sector on High-risk Difficulty.
- Unique Ability: Descending Judgment
ㄴ Reloading in midair grants Float.
ㄴㄴ Increases ATK Drop-off Starting Distance and ATK Drop-off Ending Distance.
ㄴㄴ Hitting an enemy procs HP recovery.
ㄴ When multi-hit triggers in midair, grants Atonement.
ㄴㄴ Multi-Hit Damage increases for each stack of Atonement.
ㄴ Float and Atonement are removed when you touch the ground.
(4) A-TAMS (Sniper Rifle)
- Blueprints, codes, and materials can be obtained in Sigma Sector on High-risk Difficulty.
- Unique Ability: Electronic Arche Infusion
ㄴ When aiming, continuously consumes MP to fill the gauge.
ㄴ When firing, deals increased additional damage based on the filled gauge.

Weapon
- Capped the Fire Rate of weapons at 2000.
- Added a new stat, Multi-Hit Damage.
ㄴ Each firearm has its own value, which may vary.

Void Intercept Battle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/f7f67441774d2374111f39e884944ccca5058294.jpg
- You can now check Battle Info in the Intercept Battle Entrance UI.
ㄴ The Battle Info page provides information about the stats and battle tactics of the Colossus.
Void Intercept Battles (Abyss): Tormentor
- The Colossus in the Void Intercept Battle (Abyss) has been changed to Tormentor.
- To intercept Tormentor, you must reach Mastery Rank 18 and clear the 'The Most Powerful Colossus' quest.
- Tormentor
ㄴ The Tormentor is an Electric-attributed Colossus.
ㄴ The Tormentor spawns Plasma Cubes.
ㄴ Plasma Cubes are difficult to destroy with normal attacks.
ㄴ Plasma Cubes are vulnerable to continuous damage.
ㄴ When the Tormentor enters the Void Reflux mode, it creates a thunderstorm to press the field.
ㄴ Take advantage of the Tormentor's vulnerability by actively utilizing Toxic attacks.

Photo Mode
- Added Photo Mode.
- Photo Mode is accessible through the ESC menu and can also be entered via the shortcut feature on the ring menu.
ㄴ There are no restrictions on the use of the Photo Mode feature, but it will be forcibly terminated in situations such as DBNO / death / teleport / map movement.
- You can select a pre-designated preset when entering Photo Mode.
ㄴ Presets are pre-selected shooting options for the Photo Mode, and even if you don't select a specific preset, you can set the Photo Mode options to achieve the same effects as the preset.
Preset Configuration
ㄴ Default: The default settings for Photo Mode
ㄴ Portrait: Ideal for taking portraits, applying depth of field and blurring the background.
ㄴ Background: Ideal for taking background photos, allowing you to capture a sharp shot of the entire screen.

notes.title: Operation: Kate's Experiment Assistant Continuous Operation II Compensation Dist
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants.   

 

We would like to inform you about the compensation distribution process for Descendants who completed Operation: Kate's Experiment Assistant Continuous Operation II without updating to Hotfix 1.2.8.   

 

# PST 2025.02.21(Fri) 01:20 - An additional compensation item has been added for those who received the ‘Flutter’ spawn item and purchased the ‘Lub-dub Bundle’

■ Descendants Who Received the ‘Flutter’ Spawn Item as a Continuous Operation II Reward 

(1) Distribution Schedule   

- Retrieve and distribute after PST 2025.02.21 01:00.   

※ A one-time game crash may occur when retrieving the items.   

(2) Distribution Method   

- If the ‘Flutter’ spawn item is still in your mailbox:   

  - The item will be retrieved from the mailbox, and the revised reward will be sent via mail.   

- If you have already claimed the ‘Flutter’ spawn item:

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused. We will continue striving to provide a more stable service.   

 

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.8
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants! 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.8, patched maintenance-free.


■ Patch Date
- 02.19.2025 (Wed) 23:00 PST

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details

Content Improvements 
(1) Content Improvements
- The number of Ultimate Tier External Components that can be acquired by defeating Colossi in Hard Difficulty Void Intercept Battle has increased from 2 to 8.
- The number of Hunter External Components that can be acquired by defeating Named targets in Void Vessel has increased from 1 to 8.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/993b83206c4fd994927b0fe3acab1446b2585f60.png

- Some of the monsters spawned in 28/29 Stage of Void Erosion Purge have been changed.
ㄴ Passage Range - The spawning chance for Abomination monsters has been reduced from 25% to 10%
ㄴ Battle Range - The spawning of Abomination monsters has been eliminated

(2) Weapons & Modules
- Fixed an issue where the visual effects of the "Restored Relic" Cluster Round's trajectories block your sights. 
- Improved Firearms Attribute ATK to increase according to the Weak Point Damage upon successful Weak Point Attacks.
- Some of the Value and Group of Descendant and Firearm Ultimate Modules have been changed.
Descendant Modules (Per Max Enhancement)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/3cab16ffdf2759f2806160adb790702feeac0e25.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/3c0bfc3ada2ceac1d6ac4c64385a8cc3d6d46376.png

Firearm Modules (Per Max Enhancement)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/4f6fce913f81e5a5870c693f0b027eb61d9d08ba.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/a6fd5a7d9118c73b8fe2bfc1bc6f9f26601f2323.png


(3) External Components
- Set Effects and Value of the 6 types of External Components have been partially adjusted.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/87dae985705a96cfeb308ede1cad240ea9ac3726.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/1e5095e0d685382c705cf4dda37e63ddc4197628.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/6a83361a604947aed7baf6ddddf2a97801fe723c.png

(4) UI & UX 
- Shop's  sub-category  will be displayed first. 

(5) Miscellaneous
- Added the following new options.
ㄴ You can choose the option to not display Explosive Effects of all players, including oneself.
ㄴ You can choose to hide other player's titles.
ㄴ You can choose to not display your DMG values on the screen.
- The scope of application of the following existing options was broadened.
ㄴ Handgun items can be added to the Hide Weapon on Back Option. 
ㄴ Fellow Names can be added to the Hide Nickname Option. 
- Improved to show the name of the Consumable item dropped in the Field which you already have in maximum amount.


Bug Fixes
(1) Content
- Fixed an issue where the Commander was spawned even if you did not defeat some monsters in Stage 21/24/27 of Void Erosion Purge. 

(2) Descendants
[Keelan, Ultimate Freyna, and Ultimate Sharen]
- Fixed an issue where the Gold Gain amount for the dismissal of Keelan, Ultimate Freyna, and Ultimate Sharen was less than the intentional amount. 
[Hailey]
- Fixed an issue where the visual effects of Hailey's Cryogenic effect continued to be visible even after the Duration under certain conditions. 

(3) Weapons & Modules
- Fixed the incorrect part of the description of The Last Dagger's Unique Ability. 
ㄴ The description of Strike effect has been changed as shown below. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/863e829346f974de70e077545f11f56ebc1a333a.png
ㄴ Steps effect Duration display in the Skill Info window has been changed as shown below. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/11b3006638a4c1def3d51e652e65e61d020dab03.png
- Fixed an issue where "Ancient Fire" effect was being applied to "Restored Relic" Cluster Round. 
- Fixed an issue where the Cooldown of "Continuous Exaltation" Module was not correctly applied.

(4) UI & UX
- Fixed an issue where you could not restart from the results screen after stopping a Field Mission. 
- Fixed an issue where the number of Paint items was not displayed on the Purchase Confirm pop-up screen when purchasing Paint Bundles. 
- Fixed an issue where setting "Show Only My Fellow" in Options > Gameplay > Fellow Display Settings caused all Fellows to not be displayed.

(5) Event
- Event Operation: Changed the Rewards for completing Kate's Experiment Assistant Daily Operation 30 times. 
ㄴ Please check the Event Info Page for more detailed information. 

(6) Miscellaneous
- Fixed an issue where the color of certain slots appears dark when dyeing Ines's Oasis Body Skin. 
- Adjusted the color brightness of Ines's default body skin.
- Fixed an issue of the unnatural placement of Luna's eyes when using an Enhanced Skill to the Max Gauge with the equipment of Noise Surge Module. 
- Fixed an issue of the unnatural movement of the bang of Valby's Oasis Party Head Skin. 
- Adjusted so that when a Fellow has reached the maximum carry limit for a specific Consumable, the Fellow will Auto Pickup other Consumables.
- Fixed an issue where a Fellow's Dismantle function would fail occasionally. 
- Fixed the Tooltip info to display the Cooldown of random chance Shield Recovery effects in the 4-piece set effect of Distorted Resolve External Components. 

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.7
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants!  

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.7, patched maintenance-free. 

 

■ Patch Date 

- 02.12.2025 (Wed) 23:00 PST 

 

■ Platforms 

- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5 

 

■ Patch Details 

 

Content Improvements  

(1) Void Erosion Purge Improvements 

- Public Operation is now available in stages 26 and 27 of Void Erosion Purge. 

- Changed the number of ranged skills of Elite Wardens from 8 to 3. 

- Removed the Chill status effect of Normal and Elite Trackers. 

- Changed the beam skills of Normal and Elite Farseers, Trackers, and Abominations so that the beam no longer rotates left or right as the target moves. 

- Changed the beam skill of the Commander monster Gruncah to slow down when it starts tracking a target. 

- Removed the guiding ability from the skills of Normal and Elite Annihilators and Living Artillery. 

- The drop rate of all tiers of General Rounds, Special Rounds, Impact Rounds, and High-Power Rounds has doubled compared to the previous rate. 

- Changed the reward distribution rules for Void Erosion Purge so that clear rewards are awarded upon completion of the mission regardless of the penalty duration. 

- Changed monster combinations and spawn patterns for Void Erosion Purge stages 21-30. 

ㄴ Reduced the spawn proportion of Suicide Bombers in stages 21/24/27 (5% → 1.7%) 

ㄴ Changed the Commander that appears in Stage 29 from Dmigor to Plaudia. 

Legion of Darkness 

ㄴ Changed the group spawn chance of Living Artillery (33% → 20%) 

Legion of Immortality 

ㄴ Changed the group spawn chance of Farseers (33% → 20%) 

ㄴ Reduced the number of Trackers spawning 

ㄴ Farseers and Trackers no longer spawn together 

ㄴ Removed Fortress Guards 

Order of Truth 

ㄴ Changed the group spawn chance of Annihilators (33% → 20%) 

ㄴ Reduced the number of Wardens spawning 

ㄴ Annihilators and Wardens no longer spawn together 

ㄴ Removed Ascetics. 

- Reduced the difficulty of Solo mode in Void Erosion Purge. 

- Increased Attribute ATK of weapons in Void Erosion Purge. 

- Nerfed Commander Monsters for 2-4 player modes in Void Erosion Purge. 

 

(2) Descendants 

[Ines] 

- The increase in the number of hits according to the Skill Range of Ines now changes when the Skill Range module is equipped. 

ㄴ Applied to the base skills Chain Lightning, Lightning Conductor, and Snare Hunter. 

ㄴ Applied to Floating Lightning of the skill module Time of the Hunting Hounds. 

[Keelan] 

- The increase in the number of targets according to the Skill Range of Keelan now changes when the Skill Range module is equipped. 

ㄴ Applied to the base skill Void Corrosion. 

 

(3) Weapons & Modules 

- Fixed the brightness of Albion Cavalry Gun's Ricochet effect being too bright in certain areas. 

- Made some improvements to the weapon stats and unique abilities of three Ultimate Weapons. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/9f63d9aef935792c884fb25ac5cf8cee028bebcf.png

- The weapon slot in use no longer changes when moving between fields. 

- Increased Firearm ATK of some Rare weapons. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/05f2941c1624db768087f2859776036737507d41.png

(4) UI&UX  

- Changed the Purchase button assignment as below depending on the use of Caliber. 

Buttons for non-Caliber spending purchases  

ㄴ PC: Space Bar / PS: X / Xbox: A 

Buttons for Caliber spending purchases 

ㄴ PC: F / PS: X / Xbox: A 

ㄴ A hold time of 0.5s now applies in all cases 

ㄴ Changed Accelerate Research so that you now have to press the Accelerate button directly. 

- In NPC shops, such as Deslin and Anais, you can now check the item tooltip and acquisition information at Currency Info at the top of the screen. 

- In Void Erosion Purge, the key for Next Stage has been changed to F → N on PC.  

 

(5) Products  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/b0d84cc5e43f2c651c811371eb49f3145d8b5b59.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/614ba9d9909bdb8d2dca125e18bd46172c4bf57f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/c989ec139cceef83055334da398d2f4243641796.png

Events  

(1) Challenge Events 

- The 'Operation: Kate's Experiment Assistant' event will run from after 02.12.2025 (Wed) hotfix to 02.26.2025 (Wed) 22:59 PST.  

ㄴ Daily challenges and event challenges have been added.  

- The "Operation Initiation" event will run from after the hotfix on 02.12.2025 (Wed) PST until 02.18.2025 (Tue) 22:59 PST. 

ㄴ During the event period, Descendants who log in at least once will receive a special customization item. 

- The 'Operation: Burning Embers' event will run from 02.26.2025 (Wed) 23:00 to 03.12.2025 (Wed) 22:59 PST.  

ㄴ Daily challenges and Event challenges will be added.  

 

(2) Login Event 

- The 'Operation: Daily Report' login event will run from 02.12.2025 (Wed) hotfix to 03.12.2025 (Wed) 22:59 PST.  

ㄴ The login event will run for 14 days. 

ㄴ Rewards include emotes, Ecive skins, and various materials and consumables. 

ㄴ Login everyday during the event to earn various rewards! 

 

※ For more information, please see 'Kate's Experiment: Call of the Flame Event Info' announcement.  

Bug Fixes 

(1) Content 

- When all Descendants in the No Resurrection Zone are DNO, they will now be respawned. 

ㄴ The restart count will be deducted. 

ㄴ They will respawn at a location just before the No Resurrection Zone. 

 

(2) Descendants 

- Fixed an issue where the effect icons for Lepic's Overclock, Power Unit Change, and Nerve Infiltration did not match the skill icons. 

- Partially fixed an issue where Luna's notes were delayed.  

ㄴ Fixed an issue where the music and notes would get out of sync in certain situations by removing the problematic notes at regular intervals to resync them. 

 

(3) Weapons & Modules 

- Fixed an issue where Auto-Equip for Descendant Modules would not proceed if the cursor was hovering over a Module slot by changing the key to a different button. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/3c62cc937cf167c404aa4da27cbf3400e1f5a26a.png

(4) UI&UX 

- Fixed an issue where Craft Core screen would show misalignment when the player has a large number of Cores or Core Amplifiers.  

- Changed the gamepad buttons for skipping the cutscene for Weapon Readjustment. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/e0a0f14e432f29d007ed97c67b8585458534dd60.png

- UI theme customization can now be applied to leaderboards.  

 

(5) Miscellaneous 

- Fixed an issue where some Fellow body skins were not shown when equipped.  

- Fixed an issue where other players could enter the Laboratory. 

- Fixed an issue where the dungeon icon was shown intermittently at the top left of the mini-map.  

- Fixed the unnatural wrinkles on the buttocks of Ines' default skin. 




# Director’s Comment 


Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.  

As I mentioned on Discord and Dev Livestream, this hotfix focuses on improving the gameplay experience of Void Erosion Purge while addressing elements that may have caused discomfort.   

However, the issue of certain weapon metas being overly required at higher difficulty levels has not yet been fully resolved. The reason we couldn't address this issue immediately is due to the performance gap between Descendants.   

If we balance the difficulty based on top-tier Descendants, most other Descendants will struggle to play effectively. Conversely, if we adjust the difficulty to accommodate lower-performing Descendants, the leaderboard risks being dominated by only a selected few, diminishing the content’s value as a challenge.   

To fundamentally resolve this issue, we plan to first adjust the balance between Descendants and then refine the gameplay experience of Void Erosion Purge. However, with the ongoing preparation for Season 2 Episode 2 and live service management, we regret that we cannot implement these improvements as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for this delay. We will share further details as soon as we finalize our improvement plans and schedule.   

We deeply apologize to all players who may have been disappointed with the Void Erosion Purge content. To deliver better content, we will actively seek ways to engage with the community and gather feedback before updates, ensuring a more stable live service experience.   

Thank you, as always, for your valuable feedback. 


 Thank you.
