(#1) PST 2025.02.06(Thu) 01:30 – Known Issues have been updated. 

Greetings, Descendants. 

 

Here are the major issues that were found for The First Descendant in February. 

  

We will continually update this notice with any additional issues and bugs that are found, as well as any impactful issues identified before February. Please keep track of the updates during your gameplay. 

[February 27th] 

■ (#10) Public Matchmaking Not Canceling After Switching from Private Matchmaking 

- When attempting Public Matchmaking after switching to Private Matchmaking and entering content, the Public Matchmaking request is not canceled. 

- As a result, if a player enters content via Private Matchmaking and continues playing, the Public Matchmaking request may succeed, causing the player to enter the new content unexpectedly. 


[February 19th] 

■ (#8) Missing Effect Description in ‘Continuous Exaltation’ Module Tooltip for Languages Other Than Korean/English   

- It has been identified that in languages other than Korean and English, the effect description stating that the ‘Continuous Exaltation’ module applies to the ‘1st Active Skill’ is missing.  

- Please note that the cooldown and skill power reduction effects of the ‘Continuous Exaltation’ module are applied only to the ‘1st Active Skill.’   

 

■ (#8) Awards and Battle Pass Challenges Not Counting When Responding to Support Requests   

- It has been identified that when responding to a Support Request, awards and Battle Pass Challenges requiring ‘Respond to Support Requests’ are not being counted. 

 
[February 13th] 

■(#8) (Resolved) Issue with Incorrect Description of ‘The Last Dagger’ Unique Ability Effect 

- An issue has been identified where the description of the ‘Ultimatum’ effect in ‘The Last Dagger’ unique ability was incorrectly stated. 
  ㄴ Currently Displayed: Firearm Damage × Rounds per Magazine × Damage 
  ㄴ Actual Effect: Firearm ATK × Rounds per Magazine × Damage 

- This issue will be fixed in Hotfix 1.2.8. Please note that the actual damage is being applied correctly. 

[February 12th] 

■ (#8) (Resolved) Incorrect Display of Item Quantity When Purchasing Packages (Excluding 'Paint Bundle')   

- We have identified an issue where the item quantity displayed in the ‘acquisition notification window’ is incorrect when purchasing packages from the shop, excluding the 'Paint Bundle.'   

- Please note that the actual items are granted according to the quantities specified in the bundle information.   

 

■ (#9) (Resolved)Purchase Button Appearing Active Before Reset for 'Weekly Fine Adjustment Control Axis Package' and 'Weekly Ion Accelerator Package'   

- We have identified an issue where the purchase button appears active as if the 'Weekly Fine Adjustment Control Axis Package' and 'Weekly Ion Accelerator Package' can be purchased again before the reset period, after an initial purchase.   

- Please note that clicking the purchase button during this period will not allow the purchase, and you will be able to repurchase the packages after the reset period has passed. 

 

■ (#9) (Resolved) Unable to Match When Attempting Private Matching While in Public Matching   

- We have identified an issue where attempting private matching for another content while in public matching results in an infinite matching load, preventing access to the content. 

- If you encounter this issue, please move to the title screen or reconnect to the game to resume normal gameplay. 
 

■ (#6)(Resolved) Issue with the Fellow’s Abilities Not Functioning Properly 

- An issue has been identified where the Fellow’s "Item Auto Pickup" feature is not being applied. 

- An issue has been identified where the Fellow’s "Auto-Dismantle Items" feature is being applied without a cooldown. 

- This issue is currently being addressed, and a hotfix is being prepared. Please note that the patch schedule may vary depending on the platform. We will provide further updates through an official notice once the patch is complete. 

■ (#8) (Resolved) Issue with Duplicate Shortcut Keys Applied to Quantity Adjustment Buttons in Certain UI 

- It has been identified that the same shortcut key has been redundantly applied to quantity adjustment buttons in certain UI elements. 

■ (#8) (Resolved)Operation: Kate’s Experiment Support Event Reward Display Issue

- We have identified an issue where the reward item for Operation: Kate’s Experiment Assistant Event – Continuous Operation II was incorrectly displayed.

- We sincerely apologize for the confusion caused by the incorrect reward information.

- As an apology for this issue, we will be providing additional compensation. The details of the compensation will be announced through the in-game notice “Kate's Experiment: Call of the Flame Event” on Friday, February 14.


[February 7th] 

■ (#3) (Resolved)Issue where Fellow body skins cannot be changed 

 [February 6th] 

■ The 'Restart Mission (R)' button is disabled on the result screen (F2) after aborting a mission. 
 
■(#3) (Resolved) The recent login time is not displayed in the offline friends list popup. 

- In Social > Friends > Offline Friends List, the recent login time is not shown in the popup. 

■ (#4) Issue with Duplicate Shortcut Keys Applied to Quantity Adjustment Buttons in Certain UI 

- It has been identified that the same shortcut key has been redundantly applied to quantity adjustment buttons in certain UI elements. 

[February 5th] 

■ (#8) (Resolved) The issue where the image of Hagios Sheepdog is not displayed in the Shop > Fellow menu 

- Only the image of the Hagios Sheepdog is not displayed, but the product can still be purchased normally. 

 

■ Freyna’s Exclusive Quest Icon Appearing for Other Descendants 

- Freyna’s exclusive quest cannot be played with other Descendants and can only be progressed with Freyna or Ultimate Freyna. 

 

■(#8) (Resolved)  Support Request Mission Not Disappearing from the Support Request Board After Abandonment 

 

■(#3) (Resolved) The issue where the purification score of elite monsters is applied twice in Void Erosion Purge stages 21, 24, and 27 

- In Void Erosion Purge stages 21, 24, and 27, the purification score of elite monsters is applied twice, causing you to achieve 100% purification without defeating some monsters. 

 

[Previous Known Issues] 

■ (#3) (Resolved)Issue where random mission icons occasionally appear in the top-left corner of the radar UI during field transitions. 

 

■ (#9) (Resolved)The issue where the Award names ‘Acquire Ines’ and ‘Reach Ines Level’ are displayed in English instead of the appropriate language, except for Korean. 

 

■ The issue where the Fire Rate option of the Tactical Augmentation Core (Tactical Rifle) is not applied under certain circumstances. 

- In Update 1.2.4, the Fire Rate option has been temporarily removed when equipping the Tactical Augmentation Core (Tactical Rifle). 

- This will be improved in the future to allow players to obtain the Fire Rate option once the issue is resolved. 

 

■ [PS][XBOX] Display of the Top Menu When Clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ or ‘Content Creator’ Buttons to Navigate to the Homepage 

- On the ‘PS’ and ‘XBOX’ platforms, clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ or ‘Content Creator’ buttons to navigate to the homepage results in the top menu being displayed. 

- Please note that, while navigation to other pages within the homepage is possible, actions such as ‘Login,’ ‘Start Game,’ and ‘Enter Coupon’ cannot be performed due to this issue. 

 

■ 'Sigvore's Proof' Item Progress Not Applying in Access Info. 

- There is an issue where the progress for the 'Sigvore's Proof' item is not being applied in the Access Info. 

 

■(#8) (Resolved)  [English] Mislabeling of Skin Set for male Descendant as "Unisex" in the Store 

- This issue is scheduled to be fixed in January 2025. Players who purchased the skin due to this mislabeling can request a refund. 

- Details on how to request a refund will be provided in the future "Known Issues" notice when the fix is implemented. 
* Players who purchased the skin due to this mislabeling can request a refund through our Customer Service with the account that made the purchase. 

- Please provide (1) the name of purchased Descendant skin and (2) purchase date in your request ticket. 

- Once refunded, the affected skins will be retrieved from your account. For more details, please contact our Customer Service. 

 
■ [PS5] Voice Chat Issue When Creating a Party on PS4 Platform 

- It has been identified that voice chat does not function properly when creating a party on the PS4 platform. 

 

■ Intel CPU Issue. 

- Crashes have been reported on some Intel 13th and 14th generation CPUs. 

- On PCs using these CPUs, the game may forcefully shut down with an error message stating 'Out of video memory' when launched. 

This issue can be partially resolved by adjusting power limits in the BIOS. 

- We are awaiting a response from Intel regarding this issue, and we are sharing Intel's official response for your reference. 

  

■ Temporary solutions for client termination issues with certain antivirus Programs 

- We have requested for exceptions for The First Descendant to antivirus programs, but some have not been implemented. Below are temporary solutions for this problem. 

(1) ‘Bitdefender’ Temporary Solution [FAQ] 

- Go to System Protection > Advanced Threat Detection (ATD) > Manage Exclusions menu, select the file or folder for The First Descendant, and save. 

(2) ‘McAfee Agent’ Temporary Solution [FAQ] 

- Go to McAfee Security > Navigation > Quarantined and Trusted Items, select TheFirstDescendant.exe from the quarantined programs list, and restore it. 

  

■ Solutions for ‘Easy Anti-Cheat’ not functioning correctly 

- If Easy Anti-Cheat malfunctions, refer to the FAQ for solutions. If the issue persists, please contact customer support with relevant screenshots. 

- Customer Support Access: Official Website > Customer Support > FAQ > Contact Us 

  

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.2.6
notes.content:
# 2025.02.06 (Thu) 03:00 PST – Content Improvements > (4) UI & UX

Greetings, Descendants! 


Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.6.


■ Patch Schedule
- 2025.02.05(Wed) 23:00 PST

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Update 1.2.6

Content Leaderboards
- Added the Leaderboards menu.
- The leaderboards can be checked in the Journal menu.
- The leaderboards display top 100 players.
- The leaderboards are separated according to the number of players who entered the content. (Solo, 2-player, 3-player, 4-player)
- For the Solo leaderboard, rankings are aggregated for each Descendant played.
ㄴ There are separate leaderboards for Ultimate Descendants and Normal Descendants.
- You can keep track of the records for each of your Descendant in one place.
- A notification is displayed when a new record is set.
ㄴ Enter Rankings: Top 10 overall on the leaderboard
ㄴ Solo: Top 100 overall on the Solo leaderboard
ㄴ My Record: Set a new personal record
Void Erosion Purge Leaderboard 
- Added a leaderboard to Void Erosion Purge.
- The leaderboard can be checked on the Void Erosion Purge entry screen and the Void Erosion Purge results screen.
- The Void Erosion Purge leaderboard ranks players based on their cleared stages and time. 
ㄴ The cleared stages take precedence over clear time.
ㄴ Clear time includes death penalty time.
- The Void Erosion Purge leaderboard is reset at the end of the season.
ㄴ The reset cycle for the Void Erosion Purge leaderboard may change in the future.

Craft Core
- Added Craft Core.
- Cores can be crafted through Deslin.
- Three Cores of the same tier as the Augmentation type and one Core Amplifier are used to craft one Core of the next tier.
ㄴ Core Amplifiers can be obtained from Void Erosion Purge.
ㄴ The higher the Core tier, the more Gold is required to craft it.
- If 'Auto-craft lower stages' is checked when crafting a Core, all identical Augmentation Cores of a lower tier than the Core to be crafted will be automatically registered as materials and consumed for crafting. 
ㄴ To use only Cores that are one tier lower as materials, uncheck the 'Auto-craft lower stages' checkbox. 
- You can select the quantity to craft by moving the slider, and reducing the quantity deducts lower tier Cores first as materials.
ㄴ The maximum quantity that can be crafted at one time is 300.

Void Erosion Purge Zone Addition
- New difficulties for Void Erosion Purge stages 21 to 30 have been added. 
ㄴ The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards you can obtain. 
ㄴ Public matching is available at stages 21, 25, 28, 29, and 30.
- Added Core Amplifiers to the reward for completing Void Erosion Purge.
- In the Void Erosion Purge zone, ATK is significantly amplified when using attributes that resonate with the void attribute. 
ㄴ Up to stage 20, the ATK amplification effect was strong.
ㄴ From stage 21 onwards, the ATK amplification effect gradually weakens. 
ㄴ As you get closer to the final stage, the powerful influence of Void Erosion further reduces the skill's ATK.
- Purify all eroded zones to protect Albion from the dangers of the Void.

Laboratory Improvements 
- You can now change the Vulgus level in the Laboratory to up to 260.
- You can now summon the Colossi from already completed Intercept Battles in the Laboratory.
ㄴ You can set up and summon them in the Laboratory Settings > Colossus tab.
- Added a feature to view the damage you have inflicted in the Laboratory.


■ Hotfix 1.2.6

Content Improvements 
(1) Void Erosion Purge
- Changed the placement of the Void Erosion Purge Hard CC Immunity Guide UI display.
- Added UI for the legions that appear in each Void Erosion Purge stage and their Weak Point Types information.

(2) Support Request Bulletin 
- Expired support requests are now deleted immediately.
- The Refresh button is now always displayed even if there are no support requests.

(3) Weapons & Modules
- Fixed the brightness of the beam being too bright in certain areas when using Voltia.
- Increased the maximum number of modules that you can own to 2,000.

(4) UI&UX
- Using Ecive now displays markers that differentiate Elite and Common monsters. 
- Changed the HP bar color of Elite monsters.  
- Added a marker to missions that can be played as Public Operations on the Void Erosion Purge mission selection screen.
- Changed the UX so that the options to apply are now selected and applied on the Core Equip Results screen.
- Improved visibility by adding spaces between the Core option and the tier value.
- The Core option tier values that were previously displayed in Arabic numerals in some languages are now displayed in Roman numerals.
- Added a hold time to the Purchase button that applies when Caliber is used immediately without moving to the Shop while playing the game.
ㄴ Accelerating Research
ㄴ Purchasing Battle Pass
ㄴ Purchasing presets/equipment/loadouts/storage slots
ㄴ Purchasing Customize paints
- (Added) Keyboard and mouse support has been enabled for console devices.

Bug Fixes
(1) Content
- Fixed an issue that caused the monster, Chain Explosive No. 2 Commander, which appears in the Vulgus Strategic Outpost, to stutter when appearing.
- Fixed the Void Erosion Purge time icon and line image being out of sync.
- Fixed the Hard CC Immunity UI that was displayed in Void Erosion Purge stages where Hard CC Immunity Elites do not appear so that it is no longer displayed in those stages.
- In Void Erosion Purge, pressing the Next Stage button now properly matchmakes based on the Public/Private Operation status.
- Fixed an issue where monsters were not summoned when detected by a drone in the Void Vessel. 
- Fixed an issue where some drones respawned with awkward animations in the Void Vessel. 
- Fixed an issue where after clearing an outpost, the objects inside it were not visible. 

(2) Descendants
- Fixed an issue where the Singular Skill Power Modifier did not apply correctly to the damage of Enzo’s skill, Concentrated Fire, when he was equipped with the Concentrated Fire module
- Fixed an issue where Valby's jumping motion did not display correctly when she was equipped with the Tidal Wave module.

(3) Weapons & Modules
- Fixed an issue where equipping the Explosion Range module did not affect the effect size.
ㄴ Death Roar, Guardian R4, Lightspeed Barrel, Tamed Beast, Sigvore's Proof, Vestigial Organ
- Fixed an issue where some Module effects of Beam Rifles and Launchers were not displayed in weapon information. 
ㄴ Beam Rifle – Charging Speed Increase 
ㄴ Launcher - Explosion Radius Increase

(4) UI&UX
- Fixed an issue where the Acquired locations of Hunter External Components listed the Story Dungeon. 
- Fixed an issue where the inaccessible Void Abyss Intercept Battle was not displayed as inactive in the Acquired list.
- Fixed the Acquisition Information of items obtainable in Special Operations to indicate the difficulty level.
- Fixed Void Erosion Purge so that party members cannot press the Next Stage button after clearing a stage.
- Fixed the page jump button to be disabled during Void Erosion Purge matching.
- Fixed an issue where the information on the Void Erosion Purge results screen was not properly displayed when network conditions were poor.

(5) Miscellaneous
- Fixed an issue where the setting for the Hide System Messages option would reset on client restart.
- Fixed the range and duration of Ecive that were unintentionally nerfed.
- Fixed an issue where the Next Stage button in Void Erosion Purge did not work when there was another button assigned to Next Stage.

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.5
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants. 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.5, patched maintenance-free.

■ Patch Date
- PST 2025.01.22 (Wed) 22:50

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details


Content Improvements 
(1) Content Improvements 
- Reduced the number of Elite Tracker's skill projectiles from 5 to 3.
- Obstacles have been added to Void Erosion Purge to provide cover.

(2) Weapons & Modules
- "Expand Amplification", a new firearms group, and 3 new High-Power Round Modules exclusive to launchers have been added.
- They amplify a launcher’s explosion radius, enabling attacks with a wider range.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/e42d8e0c994b4aa01d3319ba703525f864418e6e.png

(3) UI & UX 
- An improvement was made to display Core items dropped in fields with an icon exclusive for cores.
- An improvement was made to the Consumable Inventory's "Sort by: Tier."
ㄴ Change was made to Core items to be sorted by Slot Type.
- Changed the placement of the notification UI for the Fellow's Auto-Dismantle Items function.
ㄴ Previous: Above the Sub Attack button in HUD → Changed: Below the Passive Skill in HUD
- An improvement was made in Void Erosion Purge so that you can check the stage where monsters with Crowd Control Immunity are spawned.
- When the player is killed in Void Erosion Purge, you will re-spawn in a safe place.
- When Void Erosion Purge is not unlocked, requirements will be displayed in a tool tip in the World Map icon.
- Added a button that moves you to the next stage immediately after completing Void Erosion Purge.
- In the Operation Start Request Screen for each Mission, tool tips will now be displayed to describe Gold and various EXP icons.
ㄴ Targets: Gold/EXP/Mastery Rank EXP/Ironheart Particle/Weapon Proficiency EXP

(4) Miscellaneous
- The maximum number of total carriable consumables such as Amorphous Materials, Enhancement Materials, Core Materials, Basic Materials, etc. has been increased to 100 million.
ㄴ The maximum number of Shape Stabilizers that you can hold increases by the Mastery Rank.
ㄴ The number of ETA Vouchers that you can carry is same as before.
- The number of Void Abyss Metal Fragments that you can obtain by completing 400% Infiltration Operation Mission has been increased from 20 to 40.
- Fixed an issue where the player unintentionally falls out of the map in Void Erosion Purge.
 

(5) Event 
- To ensure Descendants can fully enjoy the Core Content, the exchangeable items list in the ongoing New Year's Luck Shop Event will be adjusted. 
ㄴ 5 Void Abyss Metal Fragments, originally planned as the main reward for weeks 3 and 4, will be replaced with 5 Core Particle Disruptors.
ㄴ 5 Core Particle Disruptors are added as permanent exchangeable items after the Hotfix 1.2.5 update.
ㄴ For more detailed information, please see "(In-game) New Year's Luck Shop Event)” announcement. 

Bug Fixes
(1) Content
- Fixed an issue where you could not enter the content while in a party in Void Erosion Purge.

(2) Descendants

(4) UI&UX

- Fixed an issue where, upon reconnecting, the activation conditions in the Reactor information window would appear as if they were not met under certain circumstances.

(5) Miscellaneous
- Fixed an issue where the description of the Battle Pass Week 7 Weekly Challenge, "Purifying Touch," was incorrectly displayed in some languages. 
- [Event] Fixed an issue of the discrepancy between the actual item icon of the "Ultimate Weapon Selection Box" available in New Year's Luck Shop and the product icon in the shop.

# Director's Comments


Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.
Today, I’d like to briefly share some news about our upcoming update.

As mentioned in the previous Dev Live, we will be skipping the hotfix scheduled for January 30, which coincides with the Korean Lunar New Year holiday. Instead, we are focusing on preparing for the 1.2.6 minor update, scheduled for release on February 6. This update will include support for keyboard and mouse on consoles, along with platform certifications during this period. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to delivering the minor update on February 6. 

1.2.6 Minor Update on February 6 will add Void Erosion Purge Leaderboard, 10 Tiers of Augmentation Cores, and 30 stages of Void Erosion Purge. Let's see the content advanced with some screenshots.

Void Erosion Purge Leaderboard

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/0a711d552d355d47d167c7eeb5d06c09ce49253e.jpg
(The records shown above are from the test server and irrelevant to actual gameplay.) 

We are introducing a leaderboard for Void Erosion Purge that showcases the top players who complete the highest stages in the fastest time. You’ll be able to view rankings not only by platform but also by individual Descendants. Use the leaderboard to study the most effective builds and compete with other Descendants to set record-breaking clear times! 

Augmentation Core Upgrade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/02e5dae8f45c8956fa51bdc53d618fa4177f7bb2.jpg

Craft Core can be accessed through Deslin—yes, it’s Deslin again! 😊  
This system allows you to combine lower-tier Augmentation Cores and materials obtained from Void Erosion Purge to create higher-tier Cores. With this update, you’ll be able to craft up to Tier 10 Augmentation Cores, empowering your Ultimate Weapons to reach their full potential. 

Void Erosion Purge Stage 30
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/502e26f2bcfec84323d6e399dc862e01661edb72.jpg

New stages, ranging from 21 to 30, will be added to Void Erosion Purge. 
These stages are significantly more challenging than Stage 20 and will introduce new environments to enhance the experience. The higher the stage, the better the rewards, such as higher-tier Augmentation Cores, but the difficulty will also increase accordingly. Prepare carefully and challenge these new stages to compete on the leaderboard rankings.

In addition to these updates, we’ve prepared various quality-of-life improvements, which will be detailed in a future update patch note. Also, mark your calendars for February 13, when we will release a winter hot spring-themed update. We’ll unveil new skins and share more details about future updates in early February during the next Dev Live, so stay tuned.

As we celebrate the Lunar New Year here in Korea, I’d like to take this opportunity to send my warmest regards to all our global Descendants. May this year be filled with health and happiness for you and your loved ones. We will continue to work hard to bring you joyful experiences throughout the year.

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.2.4
notes.content:
PST 2025.01.15 (Wed) 22:00 – Hotfix 1.2.4 > Content Improvements > (5) Descendants > The skill information for ‘Valby’ and ‘Ultimate Valby’ regarding the ‘Bubble Bullet’ skill has been updated.


Greetings, Descendants.

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.4.

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

 

■ Update 1.2.4


Ultimate Weapon: Weapon Core Unlock
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/b919900fd4b6be21beb00b531463f1e97b7b6ef7.png

 - Weapon Core Unlock system that upgrades performances of Ultimate Weapons has been added.

Basic Info

- Reach Mastery Rank 18 and complete Sub Quest  and proceed through NPC Deslin.
- One Lv. 100 Ultimate Weapon and one Core Binder are required to unlock a core.

Unlock Core

- When you unlock a Core using the correct weapon and Core Binder that meet the conditions, 5 Core Slots will be unlocked.
- Each slot has an assigned core type. The assigned type unlocked depends on the weapon used, and you may have several of the same type.
- You can equip Core items assigned by the Core slot type, and it also determines the type of option.
- Weapons with unlocked Cores cannot be dismantled or sold.

Options List by Core Type

- Firepower Augmentation: Firearm ATK (Explosive ATK for Launcher), extra Firearm ATK for Attacks on Colossus
- Hit Augmentation: Weak Point Damage, Firearm Critical Hit Rate, Firearm Critical Hit Damage
- Attribute Augmentation: Fire ATK, Chill ATK, Electric ATK, Toxic ATK
- Tactical Augmentation: Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate, Rounds per Magazine, Fire Rate, Reload Time Modifier, Beam Rifle Charging Speed (available for Beam Rifles only)
- Precision Augmentation: Recoil, Hip Fire Accuracy, Weapon Change Speed, Sprint Speed, Grappling Hook Charge Time Increase Rate, Aimed Shot Accuracy
- Special Augmentation: Extra Firearm ATK when attacking Legion of Darkness, Extra Firearm ATK when attacking Order of Truth, Extra Firearm ATK when attacking Legion of Immortality
- Free Augmentation: Can equip any Core item without limit. The option is determined by the type of equipped Core item.

Equip Core

- You can equip Core items to weapons that had their Cores unlocked.
ㄴ When you equip a Core item, the option is determined according to the Core type.
- Core items have Tiers. They are marked in Roman numerals (e.g., I, II, III, etc.) and the higher the tier, the better effect values they have.
ㄴ Each option has a set value range according to the Core item's tier, and the value is given within the range.
- You may also overwrite a Core item already equipped to a slot with another Core item. However, this process requires a "Core Particle Disruptor."
ㄴ When overwriting a Core item, you may choose from the existing effects and changes effects. If you do not like the new effect, choose to keep the existing one.
ㄴ However, the Core item and Core Particle Disruptor will still be consumed even if you decide to keep the existing effect.

Where to Obtain Materials

- Core Binder, an item required for Core Unlock, can be crafted through Research after collecting Void Abyss Metal Fragments from Void Intercept Battle (Void Abyss) and Infiltration Operation 400%.
- Core Particle Disruptor, an item required for Core replacement, can also be crafted through Research after collecting Void Abyss Metal Fragments.
- Core items can be acquired from Void Erosion Purge. Core items with higher tiers can be found from higher difficulties.

Quests

- When you reach Mastery Rank 18, you can see the Sub Quest  You may proceed to Core Unlock by talking to NPC Deslin after completing the quest received from the Descendant Instructor.



Ultimate Weapon: Added Basic Attribute Damage

- Basic Attribute Damage has been added to some Ultimate Weapons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/a025c36d6d791dc8927b10b70462febed975e039.png


New Descendant: Ines

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/8ebbb62f989aff107dcb4fba5fe6dfcec339ea4e.png
- Added a new Descendant, Ines.
ㄴ You can acquire research blueprints, codes, and materials from the Void Vessel Hard Difficulty.

Ines's Skills

- Passive: Plasma Oscillation
ㄴ The higher the Max MP, the greater Skill Critical Hit Rate increase.
ㄴ Critical Hits on enemies in Conductor state cause Dark Current, dealing chain damages to nearby enemies.
ㄴ Inflict Conductor Status Effect to enemies hit by the skill and deal additional damages to enemies that are already in Conductor state.

- Active 1: Chain Lightning
ㄴ Cast a jumping Lightning that affects multiple enemies to deal damage. When there is a single enemy, the Lightning jumps between the enemy and Ines repeatedly to deal damage.

- Active 2: Lightning Conductor
ㄴ Inflict damage through Current Coils to nearby enemies and generate Current Coils to all enemies in conductor state to deal damage.

- Active 3: Discharge
ㄴ This skill gathers Electricity and discharges forward with a great force. The damage increases as you charge the skill (by holding the button), and when the button is released at the peak, it deals the most damage.

- Active 4: Snare Hunter
ㄴ It throws Plasma Acceleration Coil forward to cast a Thunder Snare where it lands.
ㄴ Thunder Snare deals damage to the nearby area at regular intervals. It also generates Current Coils covering a broader area at longer intervals to deal damage.
ㄴ Ines enters a Short Circuit state when using the skill. Short Circuit state fixes Dark Current damage at maximum and increases Movement Speed.

Skill Module

- Skill Module 1: Plasma Ball
ㄴ Unlike the existing passive skill "Plasma Oscillation," it does not boost Skill Critical Hit Rate but generates Plasma Ball that defends incoming attacks from enemies for a better stability.
ㄴ The durability of Plasma Ball increases in relation to the Max MP.
ㄴ It additionally allows the character hits enemies that have conductors with a skill to deal Dark Current even without Critical Hit.
ㄴ Inflict Conductor Status Effect to enemies hit by the skill and deal additional damages to enemies that are already in Conductor state.
ㄴ You can acquire it from Kingston: Slumber Valley Hard difficulty, Obstructer Hard difficulty, and Combine Module.

- Skill Module 2: Time of the Hunting Hounds
ㄴ Active 1: Floating Lightning: Unlike Chain Lightning, it hits a small number of enemies but changes to stacking skill with a reduced Cooldown.
ㄴ Active 3 Snare Acrobatics: Gather lightning in both hands and charge forward with force. Deal damage to all targets in the path of the charge and cause a powerful explosion at the end of the path to deal damage to nearby targets. Unlike the existing Discharge Skill, its Damage, Move Distance, and Explosion Range at the final point increase with the charging stack.

- You can acquire it from Hagios: The Haven (Hard Difficulty), Frost Walker (Hard Difficulty), and Module Combine.


New Content: Void Erosion Purge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/60fec9df9908fdcd8157b43e819e44ca732b5425.png

 - Added Void Erosion Purge, a new dungeon content that allows you to challenge increasingly more difficult Difficulty.

Unlock Requirements

- Reach Mastery Rank 18, talk to the NPC Descendant Instructor and complete the quest  to unlock.
Entry Method
- The Void Erosion Purge can be accessed via the Infiltration Operations Terminal or the Void Erosion icon on the World Map.

Content Play Guide

- There are a total of 20 stages in Void Erosion Purge.
- Players start at stage 1 and the rest of the stages are locked.
- After starting the Erosion Purge, you'll need to defeat Vulgus legions to fill the target gauge. Once the gauge is full, the final Named Boss will appear. Defeat the boss to complete the Void Erosion Purge.
- Complete Erosion Purge to lock the next stage.

Determination of Outcome

- Erosion Purge Complete: If you complete the mission in the target time of 10 minutes, you will receive the rewards and unlock the next stage.
- Mission Complete: If you complete the mission but exceed the target time of 10 minutes, you will receive the rewards, but the next stage won't be unlocked.
- Mission Failed: If you fail to complete the mission and exceed all 15 minutes of playtime, you will not receive the rewards, and the next stage won't be unlocked.

Public Matchmaking

- Stage 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17 allows you to use matchmaking .
- All the other stages allow  only.

Reward Info

- Core items can be acquired as loots from defeated monsters in each stage or Mission Completion Rewards of each stage.

Miscellaneous

- When a Descendant is killed, the target time is reduced by 24 seconds. Frequent deaths may make unlocking the next stage more difficult.
- Arche Obstruction (Attribute Barrier), a new Elite effect by legion appears in Void Erosion Purge.
- Arche Obstruction (Attribute Barrier) reduces damage from the same Attribute by 81%.
ㄴ Legion of Darkness - Arche Obstruction (Fire)
ㄴ Legion of Immortality - Arche Obstruction (Electric)
ㄴ Legion of Truth - Arche Obstruction (Toxic)
- You may see the information of the Vulgus legion and their elite effects at the Void Erosion Purge Stage selection screen.
- Stage 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20 spawns Elites that have crowd control abilities, requiring a high level of battle concentration from players.


Void Intercept Battle Void Abyss: Defiler

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/20aa94a49f4076d54d8a17c50e9e5894279d75c5.png

- The Colossus in the Void Intercept Battle (Abyss) has been changed to "Defiler."
- To intercept "Defiler," you must reach "Mastery Rank 18" and clear the "The Most Powerful Colossus" quest.

Features of Defiler

- The Defiler is a Toxic-attributed Colossus.
- It creates Abyss Symbiont to strengthen itself
- Abyss Symbiont is susceptible to Electrocution effects.
- When it enters the "Void Reflux mode," it charges in like a bull.
- Rather than normal attacks, use “Electric,” the attribute that the “Defiler” is vulnerable to.

Change of ETA-0 Intercept Battle Rewards

- The rewards of Void Abyss Intercept Battle exchangeable at ETA-0 have been changed.
- Added Defiler-themed Skin and Back Attachment rewards. 
- You may continue to exchange rewards, such as the skin "Flame Keeper" and the Colotoys "Infernal Walker," even after the updates.
- You can exchange Defiler Concept Reward with "Quality Certified ETA Exchange Vouchers" that can be acquired by defeating Infernal Walkers.

Void Abyss Rotation

- The Abyssal Colossus will be featured in rotation during updates throughout the same season.
- When the Abyssal Colossus is changed, additional rewards will be added to the ETA-0 Intercept Battle, and all rewards applied to the Colossus during the same season will remain unchanged.
- The "Quality Certified ETA Voucher" acquired within the same season will also remain valid.  
- Both the ETA-0 Intercept Battle rewards and the "Quality Certified ETA Voucher" will reset in the next season.  
ㄴ Please note that the current Infernal Walker and Defiler rewards, as well as the "Quality Certified ETA Voucher" obtained during this season, will reset with the March update.


Changes in the Special Operation Hard Difficulty Map

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/8a79128246e371209370565db84dcf974c9d66c1.png

- The map of the available Special Operation Hard Difficulty has been changed.

- Difficulty and rewards have been changed.
ㄴ The difficulty was increased with a more number of spawning Elites and increased rewards and EXP.

ㄴ Added "Supersaturated Solution," an Advanced Shape Stabilizer research material, to the loot list of monsters from Hard Difficulty Special Operations.

Added Support Request Bulletin

- Added Support Requests Bulletin.
ㄴ You can check the Support Requests List through NPC Eckert in Albion.
ㄴ Mission applications will be restricted depending on your progress.
- Changed Support Request expiry from 60 sec to 120 sec.

 ㄴ You can acquire "Supersaturated Solution," the new material for Advanced Shape Stabilizer Research from monster loots of Hard Difficulty Special Operations.

■ Hotfix 1.2.4

(1) Void Vessel
- Hard Difficulty does not yield Keelan's Blueprint, codes, or materials (Refined Void Essence).

(2) ETA-0

ㄴ Previously: 23:00 Thursday - 23:00 Sunday PST 
ㄴ Changed: 23:00 Thursday - 23:00 Monday PST 

(3) Added Limited Weapons Shop

- Limited Weapons Shop can be accessed through NPC Deslin in Albion. 
- In this update, blueprints for Sigvore's Proof will be available for purchase, and Ultimate Weapon blueprints for each Battle Pass season will be added every 6 months. 
- Weapon blueprints will be available for purchase with Support Coins, which are earned by completing matches in Infiltration Operations through Other Infiltration Support. 
ㄴ Normal: Earn 2 Support Coins, Hard: Earn 5 Support Coins 

(4) Invasion
- Increased the magazine capacity of the Inversion Energy Emitter in Invasion: Order of Truth from 6 to 8 rounds.

(5) Descendants
- Readjusted the skill performance of some Descendants.

(8) Balance: Intercept Battles

- The Obstructer and Frost Walker Intercept Battles can now be entered alone when there are no matched players.

(9) Miscellaneous

- Fixed the alignment of rewards to remain the same before and after the Infiltration Support setting in Infiltration Operations.
- Improved sounds associated with the basic movement of all Descendants to be more varied for different clothing and floor materials.
- Preview Skin in the Customize screen can now be turned off.
- Added information about Target Reward to the guide for the Access Info.
- Added information about Special Operations to the guide displayed when Hard Difficulty is unlocked.
- Changed the maximum number of Quantum Incubators you can have to 100 million.
- Added 'Sort by: Expiration Date' added to the Mailbox.
- Added an option that hides the weapons on the back.
ㄴ This can be set it in ESC menu → Options → Screen → Display Settings.
- Added Preview Screenshots of Cinematics to the Graphics options.
- Failing an Infiltration Operation/Special Operation now generates a Recommended Stats Guide pop-up.
- You can now press the [Go to Web Help] button in the ESC menu to navigate to The First Descendant Web Game Guide page.
- Changed the placements of explosives (Gas Tanks/Vulgus bombs) in the field to better utilize them.
- Fixed maps to reduce the frequency of Fellow teleportation in the field.
- Fixed an issue where touching traps in Infiltration Operations and the Void Vessel did not cause damage.

Bug Fixes

(1) Content

- Fixed an issue where the excavator spawning by Gluttony would stop when the part was destroyed.

- Fixed an issue where monsters would appear late during the 400% Infiltration Operation in the Magister Lab(Kingston).
- Fixed an issue where Descendants could get stuck on doors placed in Void Vessel passageways and were unable to progress.
- Fixed an issue where the 4-set effect of external component Annihilation was applied abnormally.
ㄴ Fixed the bug of ATK increasing continuously from the time of equipping the external component, and now ATK increases normally in proportional to HP.
- Fixed an issue where the Mission Details pop-ups for Hard Infiltration Operations and Special Operations displayed incorrect information about rewards and Enhanced Vulgus special effects.

 

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.3
notes.content:
# PST 2025.01.07 (Tue) 00:20 - The patch notes for certain languages included information about the weapon hiding option. The weapon hiding option has been excluded from this patch and is scheduled to be applied in the Hotfix 1.2.4 patch. 

Greetings, Descendants. 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.3, patched maintenance-free.

■ Patch Date
- 01.06.2025 (Mon) 23:00 PST

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details

Content Improvements 
(1) Weapons & Modules
- Maximum capacity of High-Power Rounds has been increased from 25 → 50.
- Increased the efficiency of the High-Power Rounds Conversion Module. 
ㄴ General Rounds Charge Improvement: Reduced the number of General Rounds consumed from 200 → 50. 
ㄴ Special Rounds Charge Improvement: Reduced the number of Special Rounds consumed from 120 → 30.
ㄴ Impact Rounds Charge Improvement: Reduced the number of Impact Rounds consumed from 25 → 6. 
- Reduced the capacity of the High-Power Rounds Exclusive Rounds Conversion Module.
ㄴ Reduced the capacity from 16 to 6 to 12 to 2.

(2) UI & UX
- System tab has been added to the chat box.
ㄴ You can choose to display or hide the system messages in the World, Common, and Recruit tabs in the options. (However, system messages will always be displayed in the System tab regardless of the option settings.)
ㄴ You may not enter messages in the System tab.

(3) Better Control and Additional Options 
- Expanded controller sensitivity setting from 100 → 200.
- Changed the mouse sensitivity setting unit to 0.1.
- Added the mouse vertical sensitivity setting option.

(4) Miscellaneous
- Lowered the number of Invasion Disruptions required for the Battle Pass's Week 5 Challenge "Face the Invasion" from 25 times → 10 times. 


Bug Fixes
(1) Content
- Fixed an issue where Gluttony would enter Daze during the summoning animation while summoning a Mining Device.
ㄴ Gluttony and other Colossi have been fixed so that they do not enter Daze during certain hidden mechanics.

(2) Descendants
- Fixed an issue where the Out of Combat state duration for Ajax's "Void Energy" consumption was displayed in the Skill Info window as if it was increased by the Skill Duration Increase Module.
- Fixed an issue where when Sharen's "Battlesuit Melting Rounds" Module was equipped, the "MP Consumption" appeared unaffected by the "MP Cost Reduction" in the Skill Info window.

(3) UI/UX
- Fixed an issue where the "Purchase Bundle" button did not function correctly when re-entering the Customize Skin List after pressing "Back."
- Fixed an issue where the English UI text display of the "Additional Skill ATK for Colossus Attack" option in the random Reactor options had an incorrect line-break. 
- Fixed an issue where the Target/Target Reward Tracker was not updated in certain situations. 
- Fixed an issue where Bonus Coins were not given to players who reached Battle Pass Season Level 96. 
- Fixed an issue where the window appeared abnormally when the player checked Event Information through the "Ingris Search Device." 

(4) Shop
- Fixed an issue where certain exclusive Descendant products failed to display their exclusive descriptions. 
ㄴ Freyna's Vulgus Slayer, Freyna's Quarantine Clearance, Freyna Hair & Makeup 1, and Freyna Hair & Makeup 2
- Fixed an issue where discounts were not applied to the Growth/Support Packages. 
ㄴ Applicable products: Monthly Crystallization Catalyst Package, Monthly Energy Activator Package, Starter Growth Package 
ㄴ Descendants who purchased these products at the undiscounted price will have their Caliber refunded. We will notify you in a separate announcement when the refund is given. 

(5) Miscellaneous
- Fixed an issue where the normal attack of Follower Shield Bearer dealt no damage.
- Fixed an issue where some Rare Modules were not displayed in the Mission Rewards list for Other Infiltration Support in some maps of the Hard Difficulty Infiltration Operations.
- Fixed an issue where when the Descendant "Ultimate Sharen" respawned with the "Classic Maid Uniform" Body Skin equipped, the Descendant's appearance was incorrectly displayed.
- Fixed an issue where the first player could not join their allies if they were positioned in a specific location after entering the second room in the multiplayer mode of the "Fortress - Quarantine Zone" Invasion.

Thank you.

Greetings, Descendants!

Here are the major issues that were found for The First Descendant in January.
 
We will continually update this notice with any additional issues and bugs that are found, as well as any impactful issues identified before January. Please keep track of the updates during your gameplay.

[January 23rd]  

■ (#16)  Issue with Abnormally High Damage from 'Spiker' Monsters in the 'Void Corruption Purge' Mission 
- It has been confirmed that the damage dealt by ‘Spiker' monsters appearing in stages 4/8/12/16/20 of the 'Void Corruption Purge' mission is abnormally high. 
- We will address this issue as soon as the cause is identified. 

■ (#15) Issue where random mission icons occasionally appear in the top-left corner of the radar UI during field transitions. 

■ (#16) Issue with 'Launcher Explosion Radius' Information Not Updating When the 'Increased Radius' Module Is Equipped 
- Please note that this issue only affects the display of information related to the 'Launcher Explosion Radius,' and the actual effects of the Module are being applied correctly. 

[January 22nd] 
■ (#14) Issue with "Void Erosion Purge" in Party Mode
- When completing "Void Erosion Purge" in a party, the "Next Stage" button becomes active for party members. However, it has been confirmed that holding the button prevents matchmaking.

[January 21st]
■  (#14) (Resolved) Issue where the next stage is not unlocked after clearing Void Erosion Purge in 'Public Operation' mode
We found that the next stage is locked after clearing Void Erosion Purge in 'Public Operation' mode with a Descendant who has unlocked the next stage.
 
■  (#14) (Resolved) Issue where the reactor option is not applied after re-entering the game with Ultimate Viessa's 'Absolute Zero' Skill Module equipped
We found that the reactor's 'Singular Skill Power Boost Ratio' option is not applied after re-entering the game with Ultimate Viessa's 'Absolute Zero' skill module equipped.

[January 16th] 


■ (#15) (Resolved) Issue with 'Electric Conductor' Module: 'Lightning Emission' and 'High Voltage' Skills Not Increasing in Power
- When the 'Electric Conductor' module is equipped on a weapon, the 'Lightning Emission' and 'High Voltage' skills of 'Bunny' and 'Ultimate Bunny' do not increase in power based on the amount of electricity stored.


■ (#8) Issue with Setting Target Reward on Void Vessel
- We found that players who set the Target Reward to Keelan materials in the Void Vessel on Hard difficulty before the 1.2.4 update can no longer register items obtainable from the Void Vessel as Target Rewards.


■ (#15) (Resolved) Issue with Occasional Inoperability When Deactivating Target Reward in Access Info.
- If this issue occurs, restarting the game and reconnecting will resolve it, allowing for normal gameplay.


■ (#12) (Resolved) [PS5] Game Occasionally Crashes Upon Launch 
- We are currently investigating an issue where the game occasionally crashes when launched on PS5. We will address this promptly once the cause is identified. 
- (#11) The issue has been found to persist even after Hotfix 1.2.4b. We are currently identifying the cause and will resolve it as quickly as possible. 

■ (#6) 'Sigvore's Proof' Item Progress Not Applying in Access Info. 
- There is an issue where the progress for the 'Sigvore's Proof' item is not being applied in the Access Info. 

■ (#5) The issue where the Award names ‘Acquire Ines’ and ‘Reach Ines Level’ are displayed in English instead of the appropriate language, except for Korean. 


■ (#5) The issue where the Fire Rate option of the Tactical Augmentation Core (Tactical Rifle) is not applied under certain circumstances. 
- In Update 1.2.4, the Fire Rate option has been temporarily removed when equipping the Tactical Augmentation Core (Tactical Rifle). 
- This will be improved in the future to allow players to obtain the Fire Rate option once the issue is resolved. 

 
■ (#15) (Resolved) Duplicate Display of Posts in the ‘Recommended Guides’ Tab when Clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ Button 
- When accessing the guide screen by clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ button in the ‘Game Menu,’ posts in the ‘Recommended Guides’ tab are found to be displayed multiple times. 

 

■ (#5) [PS][XBOX] Display of the Top Menu When Clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ or ‘Content Creator’ Buttons to Navigate to the Homepage 
- On the ‘PS’ and ‘XBOX’ platforms, clicking the ‘Go to Web Help’ or ‘Content Creator’ buttons to navigate to the homepage results in the top menu being displayed. 
- Please note that, while navigation to other pages within the homepage is possible, actions such as ‘Login,’ ‘Start Game,’ and ‘Enter Coupon’ cannot be performed due to this issue. 

 

■ (#15) (Resolved) An issue where the icon and description are displayed abnormally in the popup when receiving Caliber after purchase 
- Please note that this issue only affects the display of information within the popup. The item is correctly delivered to the inventory upon receipt. 

 

[January 7th] 

■ (#15) (Resolved) Issue with “Mission information” not updating upon quest completion 
- An issue has been identified where the “Mission information” displayed on the left side of the game screen does not update after completing a quest.  

■(#4) (Resolved) Issue with abnormal objects placed in Albion 
- This will be resolved through the upcoming Hotfix 1.2.3b patch. 

■(#4) (Resolved)Issue with Special Operations: Hard showing only “Sterile Land – Block Kuiper Mining”  
- This issue is scheduled be fixed to show properly “Fortress - Resource Defense”, “White Night Gulch – Block Mining” in Special Operations: Hard. 
- This will be resolved through the upcoming Hotfix 1.2.3b patch.
 
■ (#4) (Resolved) Issue with ultimate descendant skin displayed as “End of Sale” in [Customize > Descendant Skins].  
- You can make a purchase ‘Ultimate Descendant Skins’ normally from the shop.  
- This will be resolved through the upcoming Hotfix 1.2.3b patch. 


[January 2nd]
■ (#1) (Resolved) Issue with Discount Not Applied to Growth/Support Packages in the Shop
- We have identified an issue where discounts were not applied to certain growth/support packages available in the shop. This will be resolved through the upcoming Hotfix 1.2.3 patch.
- The affected packages are as follows:
ㄴ Monthly Crystallization Catalyst Package, Monthly Energy Activator Package, Starter Boost Package
- Caliber spent due to this issue will be refunded. Details regarding the refund schedule will be provided in a separate announcement.

[Previous Known Issues]
■ (#5) (Resolved) An issue where Valby’s “Tidal Wave” skill deals an abnormally high amount of damage when passing through Colossus.
- This issue will be fixed in the 1.2.4 patch.

■ [English] Mislabeling of Skin Set for male Descendant as "Unisex" in the Store
- This issue is scheduled to be fixed in January 2025. Players who purchased the skin due to this mislabeling can request a refund.
- Details on how to request a refund will be provided in the "January Known Issues" notice when the fix is implemented.

■  (#1) (Resolved)Abnormal Display of Event UI through ‘Ingris Search Device’
- An issue has been identified where the event UI is displayed abnormally when accessed through the 'Ingris Search Device.'
- Please note that the event UI displays correctly when accessed via the 'Game Menu.'

■  (#1) (Resolved)Stiffness Occurs During the Mining Device Appearance in 'Gluttony'
- An issue has been identified where a stiffness effect occurs during the mining device appearance sequence while playing the 'Gluttony' Interception mission.
- This issue will be resolved in the Hotfix 1.2.3 patch.

■ (#1) (Resolved) Inability to Obtain Battle Pass 'Bonus Coins'
- An issue has been identified where 'Bonus Coins' are not granted when clicking the 'Obtain Bonus Coins' button in the Battle Pass UI after reaching Season Level 96.

■ (#1) (Resolved) Preview Issue for Default Hair When Selecting Makeup with Certain Head Skins Equipped
- When equipping certain head skins that cover the face and selecting makeup items in the shop, the preview does not display the default hair of the Descendant.

■ (#1) (Resolved) Issue with Temporary Visual Abnormalities When Equipping Certain Head Skins
- An issue has been identified where the appearance of a character may temporarily display abnormally when certain head skins are equipped.

■ [PS5] Voice Chat Issue When Creating a Party on PS4 Platform
- It has been identified that voice chat does not function properly when creating a party on the PS4 platform.

■ Intel CPU Issue.
- Crashes have been reported on some Intel 13th and 14th generation CPUs.
- On PCs using these CPUs, the game may forcefully shut down with an error message stating 'Out of video memory' when launched.
This issue can be partially resolved by adjusting power limits in the BIOS.
- We are awaiting a response from Intel regarding this issue, and we are sharing Intel's official response for your reference.
 
■ Temporary solutions for client termination issues with certain antivirus Programs
- We have requested for exceptions for The First Descendant to antivirus programs, but some have not been implemented. Below are temporary solutions for this problem.
(1) ‘Bitdefender’ Temporary Solution [FAQ]
- Go to System Protection > Advanced Threat Detection (ATD) > Manage Exclusions menu, select the file or folder for The First Descendant, and save.
(2) ‘McAfee Agent’ Temporary Solution [FAQ]
- Go to McAfee Security > Navigation > Quarantined and Trusted Items, select TheFirstDescendant.exe from the quarantined programs list, and restore it.
 
■ Solutions for ‘Easy Anti-Cheat’ not functioning correctly
- If Easy Anti-Cheat malfunctions, refer to the FAQ for solutions. If the issue persists, please contact customer support with relevant screenshots.
- Customer Support Access: Official Website > Customer Support > FAQ > Contact Us
 
Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.2
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants. 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.2, patched maintenance-free.

■ Patch Date
- 12.18.2024 (Wed) 18:15 PST

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details
Content Improvements 
(1) Balance: Intercept Battles
- Molten Fortress and Gluttony Intercept Battles have been changed to allow for solo matchmaking.
- The following nerfs have been applied to Molten Fortress and Gluttony:
※ If you have not downloaded the Hotfix 1.2.2 update, you may be able to enter the Void Intercept Battle solo without the difficulty adjustment applied. Please make sure to update your game before participating in the Intercept Mission.
Molten Fortress
ㄴ If the beam of a Frenzy Suppressor is linked correctly to another device during the Frenzied state, this device can no longer be operated or changed afterward.
ㄴ Adjusted the spawn timing of Frenzy Suppressors to spawn when the Molten Fortress rises from the ground during its Frenzied state.
ㄴ Adjusted the number of Roly-poly summoned by the Molten Fortress from 8 to 4 during the Normal state and 6 during the Frenzied state.
ㄴ Molten Fortress now enters the Frenzied state less frequently.
Gluttony
ㄴ Adjusted the Impurity to be drawn to Gluttony when they are within a 15m radius of Gluttony.
ㄴ Adjusted the amount of the Wipe Attack Gauge that increases when the Unstable Energy is absorbed by Gluttony from 20% to 10%.
ㄴ Unstable Energy explosions required to cancel the Frenzied state now doubled, making it easier to cancel.
ㄴ Gluttony now moves around the center of the map more frequently.
ㄴ Adjusted the cooldown of Gluttony's Melee Attack (raking the ground with its arms) from 5 seconds to 20 seconds.
ㄴ Adjusted Gluttony's basic shotgun attack so that it can be used at close range.
ㄴ Gluttony now enters the Frenzied state less frequently.
ㄴ Reduced Gluttony's ATK by approximately 47.4%.

(2) Balance: Reactors
- The "Attribute Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Reactors of the same Attribute.
ㄴ The "Chill Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Chill Reactors.
ㄴ The "Non-Attribute Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Non-Attribute Reactors.
ㄴ The "Fire Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Fire Reactors.
ㄴ The "Toxic Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Toxic Reactors.
ㄴ The "Electric Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Electric Reactors.
ㄴ The "HP Heal Modifier" random option can only be acquired from Non-Attribute Reactors.

(3) Balance: Descendants
- Adjusted the duration of Active Camouflage when using Ultimate Sharen's skill module "Ambushed" from 4 seconds to 6 seconds.
- Adjusted the cooldown of some of Keelan's skills.
ㄴ Septic Gust: 60 seconds → 35 seconds
ㄴ Tremor: 80 seconds → 60 seconds
- Adjusted Keelan's Skill Module "Focus on Prey."
ㄴ Adjusted the damage per Acidic Decay stack of Tremor.
Lv. 1: 470.3% → 655.5%
Lv. 2: 480% → 670%
Lv. 3: 488.6% → 683%
Lv. 4: 494.8% → 692.2%
ㄴ Adjusted the cooldown of the Void Corrosion skill from 10 seconds to 8 seconds.
- Adjusted Keelan's Skill Module "Mobile Strike."
ㄴ Adjusted the cooldown of the Hunting Time skill from 150 seconds to 55 seconds. 
ㄴ Adjusted the duration of the Adventurer's Spirit effect of Hunting Time from 3 seconds to 4 seconds. It is now affected by the "'Skill Duration Increase" stat.
ㄴ Keelan cannot move to a higher position by using the Onslaught skill while the Adventurer's Spirit effect is active. The delay after pressing the skill button has been reduced.

(4) Content
- Added the "Start Private Operation" feature to Special Operations.
ㄴ The difficulty level will not be adjusted according to the number of players. Only the individual/party that has applied to enter will be able to participate in the Special Operation.
- Changed the Sphere mechanic of Commander monsters that appear in the following content to the Monster Extermination mechanic.
ㄴ Kingston: Slumber Vally (Normal/400%), Magister Lab (400%), and Albion Resource Defense (Normal/Hard)
ㄴ Sterile Land: Unknown Laboratory (400%), The Forgottense (400%), Kuiper Refinery (Normal/Had), Repository: Vulgus Strategic Outpost (Normal/Hard), and Kuiper Mine Blockade (Normal)
ㄴ Vespers: The Shelter (Normal), Void Fusion Reactor - Vespers Ruins (Normal/Hard), Void Fusion Reactor - Vespers Lost Supply Depot (Normal/Hard), and Moonlight Lake: Vulgus Strategic Outpost (Normal/Hard)
ㄴ Fortress: Quarantine Zone (400%) and Albion Resource Defense (Normal/Hard)
- Amorphous Material Patterns that can be obtained from the Outposts in each Zone can now be earned as Selectable Rewards in Infiltration Operations in the same Zone.
ㄴ Upon completing a mission on Normal Difficulty, you can earn 1 Amorphous Material Pattern.
ㄴ Upon completing a mission on Hard Difficulty, you can earn up to 2 patterns depending on your total score based on the Kill Score Multiplier.
- Falling or cancelling Grappling Hooks no longer counts as jumping. 

(5) UI & UX
- Improved the Library to display the Research progress in the Details based on the actual Research status.
- On PC, opening the Ring Menu now moves the cursor to the center of the Ring Menu.

(6) Miscellaneous
- Added "Quick Turn" as an option in Controller > Normal Button Settings > User Settings.
ㄴ The button for this feature is not included in the Default settings and needs to be set separately. 
ㄴ If Sprint is set as the movement option, using the L3 button makes it easier to use this feature. 
- When a Commander monster's phase changes, the movement location guide is now displayed for a longer duration.
- The difficulty of the Valby Evolving Skin quests has been reduced.
ㄴ Stage 2: Pass through 10,000 enemies with the Clean Up skill → 3,000 enemies
ㄴ Stage 3: Pass through 20,000 enemies with the Clean Up skill → 6,500 enemies


Bug Fixes
(1) Descendants
- Fixed an issue where using Esiemo's Arche Explosion or Creative Explosion skill during an Emote displayed the incorrect motions.
- Fixed an issue where Turrets could be removed when using Jayber's Reactivate or Immediate Purge Code skill.
- Fixed an issue where Jayber's other skills were not available when using his Reactivate or Immediate Purge Code skill.

(2) Weapons & Modules
- Fixed an issue where the effect of the Descendant Ultimate Module "MP Collector" would sometimes not activate when the module was equipped.

(3) UI/UX
- Fixed an issue where the Owned icons on Descendant portraits would disappear when scrolling on the Usage Information screen of the Common Skins in the Customize menu.
- Fixed an issue where the color change shortcut button was not displayed in the tooltip of the Fellow Skin equipped in the Customize menu.
- Fixed an issue where entering the game through the "Go to the Last Played Map" would reset the Junk Filter.
- Fixed an issue where attempting to check the Details of an equipped Emote in the User Settings menu of the Ring Menu did not display the Details and unequipped the Emote instead.
- Fixed an issue where, after removing a Target Reward, clicking the empty slot in the Target Reward List would freeze the game on PC. 
- Fixed an issue where the discount rate was not applied correctly when purchasing Bundles that included already-owned components. 
- Fixed an issue where the text "Exclusive Item" was not displayed for some products.

(4) Miscellaneous
- Fixed an issue where the Dread Armor Force did not trigger the trap mechanics normally in the Void Vessel. 
- Fixed an issue where the amount of Gold earned on the Results screen of a Special Operation on Hard Difficulty sometimes displayed the amount of Gold owned. 
- Fixed an issue where the ETA Intercept Battle, Infiltration, and Supplies Exchange awards were not checked.
- Fixed an issue where your Target Reward gauge would reset if another player obtained your Target Reward item during Void Intercept Battle.
- Fixed an issue where the default skin was not displayed after dismissing the Descendant.

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants! 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.1, patched maintenance-free.

■ Patch Date
- 12.11.2024 (Wed) 23:00 PST

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details


Content Improvements 
(1) Addition of Infiltration Support Function 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/d072baa8076e99986ba79c33cd5c2a115b2c4b04.png
- When starting an Infiltration, you can activate the "Other Infiltration Support" setting.
ㄴ Activating this option allows you to enter different Infiltration Operations from the currently selected one, with a low number of Descendants.
ㄴ Infiltration Support targets Operations that have the same Difficulty and Kill Score Multiplier as the one selected.
ㄴ You cannot carry out Private Operations when Other Infiltration Support is enabled.
- Other Infiltration Support is unavailable under the following conditions.
ㄴ You can only support Infiltration Operations that you have cleared at least once on Normal Difficulty.
ㄴ Other Infiltration Support is unavailable on Hard Difficulty with the 400% multiplier.
ㄴ Other Infiltration Support is unavailable if you're in a 4-player party.
- Rewards available from Other Infiltration Support are as follows.
ㄴ Rewards dropped from enemies are based on the Infiltration Operation currently being played.
ㄴ Infiltration Operation Success Rewards are based on the Infiltration Operation that was selected.
ㄴ Selectable Rewards for Hard Difficulty Infiltration Operations are also based on the Infiltration Operation that was selected.
ㄴ The drop rate of the Selectable Rewards is determined by the score table of the Infiltration Operation that you entered.
Quests
- When clearing an Infiltration Operation, the quest progress increases based on the Infiltration Operation that you entered.

(2) Balance
- Upon entering content, the capacity of High-Power Rounds has been increased from 5 to 15.
- The base ‘Weapon Spec’ of the next ultimate weapons have been adjusted
ㄴ The basic ammo capacity of ‘After Glow’ has been increased from 6 to 12.
ㄴ The basic ammo capacity of ‘Piercing Light has been increased from 6 to 11.
ㄴ The basic ammo capacity of ‘Smithereens’ has been increased from 7 to 15.
ㄴ The basic ammo capacity of ‘Executor’ has been increased from 8 to 14.
ㄴ The ‘Explosion ATK Drop-off Range’ of ‘Restored Relic’ has been decreased from 50% to 10%.
ㄴ The ‘Launcher Explosion Radius’ of ‘Restored Relic’ has been increased from 4.7m to 8.3m.
ㄴ The crosshair recovery speed of ‘Smithereens’ and ‘Executor’ has been increased by approximately 30%.
ㄴ The ‘Firearm ATK’ of ‘Smithereens’ has increased by approximately 62%.

(3) Content
- White-night Gulch: In the Mystery's End - Infiltration Operation on Hard Difficulty, the monster that used to spawn behind the trap now spawns in front of it.
- Updated White-night Gulch: Mystery’s End - Infiltration Operation 400% to allow you to obtain the 'Heavy Ion Collector.'
- Improved the location of Records in the Void Vessel Record Quest to make progression easier.
- Blueprint Boxes for Keelan and Fellowes can now be acquired in turn for each tier upon completing the Void Vessel, instead of only one of them appearing as before.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Season 2 Store Issues and Compensation
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants.  

 

We’d like to provide additional guidance regarding the discount labels for the Ultimate Bundle and address the issue of discounts not being applied to the Fellow Bundle. 

First, we’d like to apologize for the insufficient explanation about the Ultimate Bundle regarding changes to the store introduced with the Season 2 update. 

Before the Season 2 update, all Ultimate Bundles already included discounted prices. However, due to legal requirements, we couldn’t label them as "discounted" since not all individual items in the bundle were available for separate purchase.  

With the Season 2 update, one of the most requested changes by Descendants—separate purchase for all cosmetic items—has been implemented. As a result, we’ve also added discount labels to the bundled products.  

Additionally, we’ve identified an issue where discounts were not properly applied when purchasing the Fellow Bundle while already owning some of the included items. 

This issue will be resolved in the upcoming Hotfix 1.2.0c patch, and we’ll be refunding Calibers spent due to this issue. The refund schedule for affected Caliber will be announced in a separate notice.  

We sincerely apologize once again for not providing sufficient prior explanations about the store discount labels and for the inconvenience caused by the Fellow Bundle discount issue.

As a token of apology to our Descendants who have experienced inconvenience, we’ll be providing a Crystallization Catalyst. 


■ How to Claim Reward 

- All Descendants who login during 2024.12.06(Fri) PST 04:00 ~ 2024.12.12(Thu) PST 23:00 will receive reward via mailbox 

 

■ Mailbox Expiration Date 

- 2024.12.19(Thu) 22:59 PST 

※ Please receive reward before mail expires. 

 

■ Reward  

- 1 Crystallization Catalyst  
 

We hope you enjoy a joyful and warm holiday season with The First Descendant Season 2, and we’re committed to delivering even better service in the future. 


Thank you.

notes.title: Plans for Season 2 Update Content Issues
notes.content:
Greetings, Descendants.  

 

We are planning to address issues arising from the main content updates in Season 2.  
We will provide additional updates to this notice as the preparations progress. 

 
■ Improvement of Misunderstood Participation Conditions Due to Void Vessel Quest Path Issues 

The Void Vessel content becomes accessible via the Void Vessel Operations Terminal after completing the quest Unidentified Void Vessel Exploration Mission (Void Vessel tutorial completed once). You can then participate in Void Vessel: Normal and Void Vessel: Hard. 

However, due to unclear quest guidance, many players have misunderstood that they must complete the Data Recorder Collection stage to progress. This has caused difficulties for many players attempting to complete the quest. 
To address this issue, we plan to implement the following changes in the 1.2.0c hotfix scheduled for Saturday, December 7. 

The ‘Collect Recording Devices’ will be converted into a side quest. 
The Move to Void Vessel for Data Collection button will now be redirected to the Void Vessel Operations Terminal. 
These changes aim to clearly distinguish quests that are not mandatory and help players easily recognize that they can already play Void Vessel Operations.  

Additionally, we plan to further refine the ‘Collect Recording Devices’ side quest through a future hotfix for a smoother gameplay experience. 
You can freely play the Void Vessel Dungeon via terminal after completing the tutorial once. Players who prioritize combat and farming over story progression can complete this quest later at their convenience. 

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and will continue striving to provide a better gaming experience. 

 

Thank you.

- This issue will be fixed in Hotfix 1.2.1 to allow Target Reward removal via a hold-button mechanism.

■ (Resolved) Issue: Ability to View and Target Previous Optimization Conditions in the Ultimate Tier Reactor List
- Before the Season 2 update, some ultimate tier Reactors with optimization conditions set to "When using individual weapons" can still be viewed and have targets set in the information browsing section.
- Since the Season 2 update, the optimization condition for ultimate tier Reactors has been changed to "When using weapon group", and these reactors can no longer be obtained.

■ (Resolved) Shields Applied to ‘Vulgus War-Slave’ in Certain Segments of the Fortress Special Operation Hard Difficulty
- In the Fortress Special Operation: Albion Resource Defense at Hard difficulty, shields have been applied to the ‘Vulgus War-Slave monsters in certain segments.

■(Resolved) Season Level Purchase Popup Displayed After Reaching Battle Pass Level 96
- After reaching Battle Pass level 96 and claiming all rewards, a Season Level Purchase popup may appear upon clicking the " Claim Rewards per Page" button before reaching level 97.
- Attempting to make a purchase through the popup does not result in any actual transaction.

■ (Resolved) Unable to Apply Dye to the ‘Prepared Speedster’ Skin
- An issue has been identified where dye cannot be applied to the ‘Prepared Speedster’ skin.  

■ (Resolved) Unable to Clear the Vespers ‘Captured Base’ Mission
- During the Vespers region’s ‘Captured Base’ mission, the mission does not clear even after defeating all the monsters.  

■ (Resolved) Intermittent Inability to Clear the Echo Swamp ‘Arche Motion Sensor’ Mission  
- In the Echo Swamp region’s ‘Arche Motion Detector’ mission, the mission may intermittently not clear even after defeating all monsters.  

■ (Resolved) ‘Cutlasser’ Monster Failing to Detect Descendants in the Vespers ‘Captured Base’ Mission 
- During the Vespers region’s ‘Captured Base’ mission, the ‘Cutlasser’ monster fails to detect Descendants.  

■ (Resolved) Escort Drone Fails to Move if Descendants Are Not Nearby in the Vespers ‘Ruins Path’ Mission
- In the Vespers region’s ‘Ruins Path’ mission, the Escort Drone does not move if Descendants are not positioned nearby.  

■ (Resolved) [PS/XBOX] Abnormal Screen Display When Accessing the Customization Menu via the Ring Menu
- On PS and XBOX platforms, entering the Customization menu via the ring menu causes the screen to display abnormally.

[November]
■ Issue with Temporary Visual Abnormalities When Equipping Certain Head Skins
- An issue has been identified where the appearance of a character may temporarily display abnormally when certain head skins are equipped.

■ [PS5] Voice Chat Issue When Creating a Party on PS4 Platform
- It has been identified that voice chat does not function properly when creating a party on the PS4 platform.

■ Intel CPU Issue.
- Crashes have been reported on some Intel 13th and 14th generation CPUs.
- On PCs using these CPUs, the game may forcefully shut down with an error message stating 'Out of video memory' when launched.
This issue can be partially resolved by adjusting power limits in the BIOS.
- We are awaiting a response from Intel regarding this issue, and we are sharing Intel's official response for your reference.
 
■ Temporary solutions for client termination issues with certain antivirus Programs
- We have requested for exceptions for The First Descendant to antivirus programs, but some have not been implemented. Below are temporary solutions for this problem.
(1) ‘Bitdefender’ Temporary Solution [FAQ]
- Go to System Protection > Advanced Threat Detection (ATD) > Manage Exclusions menu, select the file or folder for The First Descendant, and save.
(2) ‘McAfee Agent’ Temporary Solution [FAQ]
- Go to McAfee Security > Navigation > Quarantined and Trusted Items, select TheFirstDescendant.exe from the quarantined programs list, and restore it.
 
■ Solutions for ‘Easy Anti-Cheat’ not functioning correctly
- If Easy Anti-Cheat malfunctions, refer to the FAQ for solutions. If the issue persists, please contact customer support with relevant screenshots.
- Customer Support Access: Official Website > Customer Support > FAQ > Contact Us
 
Thank you.
